A severe heatwave ends abruptly with Bondi experiencing the biggest hailstorm in 20 years. Harrison makes a daring move to save members of a Korean tour group caught in a rip. Reidy attempts to become the greatest Bondi Santa and the lifeguards receive a special Christmas gift from a local legend.

A suspected body is seen floating in the water, prompting the launch of the jet ski. Ryan encounters trouble as he bogs the buggy. Jethro dislocates his shoulder on the jet ski and is taken to the hospital. Ryan redeems himself by rescuing a young man bouncing off the bottom of the ocean.

On the day of the lifeguard challenge, Max and Jesse chase an inflatable boat ride, leading to further trouble when Jesse gets a buoy rope stuck in the jetski intake. The lifeguards deal with tourists using cheap boogie boards whose arm leashes break, causing them to quickly sink in deep water.
A crippling heatwave hits Bondi. Trainee Lachie will find out if he has made a big enough impression on Hoppo and the team to earn him a permanent spot on the Bondi lifeguard squad.

New trainee Jethro earns praise from senior lifeguards for rescuing a man more than double his size, but his fortunes reverse when he accidentally locks himself in the lifeguard tower and struggles to find a way out. Later he is faced with a woman found barely alive at the bottom of the cliffs.
The Bondi community is rocked when a brawl takes place at the North End. A lifeguard race adds to the action. Harries and Tommy are involved in rescues... but can Tommy successfully back up Harries?

In soaring temperatures, a 2-year-old girl is trapped in a locked car. A mother and daughter are saved by a man who can barely swim himself. Lifeguards catch a bag thief, who sends them on a chase. Harrison must improvise for equipment when he spots swimmers going under after pack-up time.

Lifeguard Maxi juggles lifeguarding and firefighting duties. An Iranian tourist is pulled ashore unresponsive and they battle the language barrier as they try to assess if it's a spinal, drowning, or head injury. Harries comes against his own language barrier with the rescue of an Irish tourist.

Heidi Klum joins Bondi's celebrity roll call. But will the lifeguards look up to scratch when they appear in her latest photo shoot? In the water, Harrison faces an impossible choice: one lifeguard, three drowning swimmers. In the lifeguard tower, a severely dislocated knee gets emergency surgery.

The biggest mass rescue at Bondi in years sees over 40 swimmers in trouble, the beach closed and lifeguards stretched to their limits. Former pro surfer Nicola Atherton is the 4th ever female lifeguard to join the team. She finds herself on the frontline of a mass rescue.

On the predicted hottest day of summer, Bondi lifeguards brace for a huge crowd. Hoppo saves a drowning Chinese student. Evo rescues a semi-conscious woman. Newbies Matt and Noah face a test of their skills in front of their peers. To add to their stress levels, the lifeguard radio goes dead.

The national borders are open and international tourists flock to Bondi. Hoppo picks a random beachgoer to demonstrate his Float To Survive technique. Chase meets a local diver who invites him to check out Bondi's grey nurse shark colony.

Harrison sees 2 girls drowning in Backpackers rip. Film students unintentionally capture their own drowning on a GoPro. Maxi pursues a bag thief on Bondi's main road, and Harries experiments with bagpipes. Lifeguards engage in a discussion with Australian war hero and double amputee Damien Thomlinson.

On New Year's Day, hundreds of Dutch revelers hit the water. The festivities turn serious as a teenage girl has a drug overdose. Chappo rescues two Korean teenagers but faces a dilemma, with two men further out. Lifeguards assist a former lifeguard who lost his house to bushfires.

A car free falls off a ledge onto a busy walking track. A man harassing women on the beach flees from police, who require a helicopter, boat and jetski to catch him. Joel enlists his ironman champion brother, Matt Bevilacqua, to aid him in the Annual Lifeguard Race.

Bloodsucking bugs go on the attack! Coyote lets these parasites bite in real time to show how fast they latch and how to stop them.The echidna looks cute, but its spikes say otherwise. Mark handles this spiny Australian mammal and explains its strange biology.

programmes.t: Don't Touch! – Up Close with a Rattlesnake!

programmes.t: Stung by the Gympie Gympie! (World's Most Painful Plant Sting)
programmes.d: Coyote braves the Gympie Gympie, Australia's infamous pain plant. The sting leaves lasting effects and is known to bring grown men to tears.With nothing but his bare hands, Coyote tries catfish noodling—reaching into muddy water for a hidden monster. It's wild, messy, and risky.

programmes.t: Giant Frog Kissed! – Prince or Princess?
programmes.d: In a fairytale-worthy twist, Coyote kisses a giant frog in the name of science and fun. Does it turn into royalty? You'll have to see.A sobering episode recounts a fatal snake bite case. Coyote shares what went wrong and what to do in the event of a venomous encounter.

programmes.t: Milking the World's Most Venomous Spider!
programmes.d: Coyote attempts to milk the world's most venomous spider in a high-stakes episode filled with fangs, silk, and scientific precision.With panda-like fuzz and a sting that ranks among the worst, this ant is no pushover. Mark explains what makes the panda ant so formidable.
Things go south during a venom extraction. Coyote experiences the dangers firsthand in this episode where snake milking takes a scary turn.

The mantis shrimp packs the fastest punch in nature. Coyote shows how its explosive strike can shatter shells—and maybe more.Maggots vs feet? Coyote steps into 300,000 larvae to demonstrate their bizarre biological purpose and what happens when they swarm.

programmes.t: The Curious Case of Benjamin Button
programmes.d: Born under unusual circumstances, Benjamin Button (Brad Pitt) springs into being as an elderly man in a New Orleans nursing home and ages in reverse. Twelve years after his birth, he meets Daisy, a child who flickers in and out of his life as she grows up to be a dancer (Cate Blanchett). Though he has all sorts of unusual adventures over the course of his life, it is his relationship with Daisy, and the hope that they will come together at the right time, that drives Benjamin forward.

But in private, Hughes remains tormented, suffering from paralyzing phobias and depression. The higher he rises, the farther has to fall.

Gilbert Grape (Johnny Depp) is a small-town young man with a lot of responsibility. Chief among his concerns are his mother (Darlene Cates), who is so overweight that she can't leave the house, and his mentally impaired younger brother, Arnie (Leonardo DiCaprio), who has a knack for finding trouble. "Destiny fulfilled" Munho makes a second request to Healer: to find out everything about Chae Yeongsin. While investigating Yeongsin, Jeonghu learns one thing about her past. The client, Jeonghu met on the subway was found dead, and Healer is named the prime suspect. Minja warns Jeonghu to wrap up, but Jeonghu finds some interesting things in Yeongsin's vicinity...

"The first kiss on that day" Munho is still miserable because of the memories of that day, which he cannot erase. Once she finds out that a big shot is behind Yunhui, Yeongsin struggles with whether or not to write the story. Jeonghu monitors Yeongsin in order to catch the person who framed him, and notices another person watching Yeongsin: Munho.

"Because I'm by your side" Jeonghu continues to work undercover in order to use Yeongsin as bait. Yeongsin publishes an article that disturbs high-ranking officials, and Munho senses the danger that will befall her. Jeonghu faces a situation in which he must choose between his safety and Yeongsin's safety...

"What you mean to me" After the Healer appears, Yeongsin becomes Sangsu's gang's target, and Minja warns Jeonghu not to start anything. Munho hesitates, debating whether or not to tell Myeonghui about Jian, and ends up facing off with Munsik. Yeongsin goes to meet President Hwang to do a follow-up investigation on Joo Yeonhui's case, and takes Jeonghu with her. However, Sangsu's gang was already there to protect him, and Detective Yoon, who followed them, was also there.

"It begins" Thanks to Jeonghu's quick thinking, Yeongsin escapes from President Hwang's house and is questioned by Detective Yoon. Meanwhile, Jeonghu succeeds in luring Sangsu out. After Munsik uses the media to frame Joo Yeonhui for being a seductress, Yeongsin is overwhelmed and calls Munho. That night, Jeonghu hears a shocking confession from Yeongsin. And then... he came.

"Us under the sunset" Munho begins his one-on-one training of Yeongsin to turn her into a real reporter, and Jeonghu finds Munho to be an eyesore. Munsik is suspicious of Yeongsin and conducts a background search on her, and Jeonghu, who is busy with his dual life, receives a new job request: to protect Yeongsin. Then, Yeongsin receives a text message... from sender: "Healer."

Yeonwoo, the daughter of the Chief Scholar of Hongmungwan, enters the palace to attend the celebratory banquet honoring her brother's success in the civil service examination. At the same time, Crown Prince Hwon vaults over the wall of Eunwol Pavilion—only to run straight into Yeonwoo. Mistaking him for a thief, Yeonwoo confronts Hwon, but upon noticing the handkerchief he gives her, she realizes he is none other than the Crown Prince.

Yeom, the son of the Chief Scholar, is a man of irresistible charm who, after placing first in the state examination, is appointed as the Crown Prince's tutor. Displeased with his young teacher, Hwon engages in a tense battle of wits with Yeom—unaware that he is Yeonwoo's brother.

When Nokyoung encounters Yeonwoo and Bogyeong together, she senses an ominous presence. Queen Dowager Yoon orders that the physiognomy of the young maidens be examined in preparation for selecting a future queen. Meanwhile, Princess Minhwa takes Yeonwoo and Bogyeong into her care as court maidens and, upon discovering that Yeonwoo is Yeom's younger sister, begins to openly favor her.

The Yoon Daehyeong faction schemes to place Bogyeong as the future queen of Gyotaejeon. Ahead of the royal selection of the Crown Princess, Hwon secretly expresses his wish for Yeonwoo to submit her maiden registration. Meanwhile, Princess Minhwa's feelings for Yeom deepen, and she stubbornly demands that the king grant her permission to marry him.

Yeonwoo remains at the royal villa, Eunwol Pavilion, devoting herself to rigorous court etiquette training. Unable to withstand the Queen Dowager Yoon's threats, Nokyoung casts a forbidden spell on Yeonwoo. Cast out of the palace and sent back to her family, Yeonwoo's illness steadily worsens. In secret, Nokyoung approaches Yeonwoo's father with a dangerous proposal.

Trapped in terror inside a coffin, Yeonwoo is ultimately rescued by Nokyoung and returned to the world—only to awaken with all her memories erased. Taking Yeonwoo's place, Bogyeong ascends as Crown Princess. As Crown Prince Hwon comes of age, the kingdom's political situation grows ever more precarious under the schemes of powerful in-law families.

To convince the dance-averse Huckleberry to attend the big masquerade ball at the dog park, Blueberry promises she'll stay by his side the whole evening and make sure he doesn't have to dance. Lemon and Raspberry misinterpret her sniffles, thinking she's so heartbroken to be disappointing Huck that she's crying!

programmes.st: The Berry Biggest, Berry Baddest Bakeoff
programmes.d: Berry Bitty City is abuzz as Berrykin Bloom introduces the biggest, juiciest, strangest fruit anyone has ever seen! It's the size of a house, shaped like a strawberry, colored like a watermelon and has a spiky pineapple top. "I call it the sparklestrawwaterpineberry!" says Berrykin Bloom. Princess Berrykin declares it the greatest achievement in Berryculture she's ever witnessed.
Lemon and Raspberry hire twins Sweet & Sour to help out in Strawberry's café, so Strawberry will have time to appear in an internet fashion contest.

Strawberry's world-traveling cousin Apple Dumplin' stops at Berry Bitty City. What starts as a brief visit becomes a series of comical misadventures that ends with Apple finding a new home with Strawberry and her friends.

Lemon and Raspberry's fashion podcast is saved by Apple, then almost sabotaged by Sweet and Sour when Lemon's "mood hair" runs amok, acting like the bickering twins, and the twins' comical argument is accidentally broadcast on the "berrynet."

When Sour wishes she could have a birthday all her very own, her twin sister Sweet grants her wish by forgoing celebrating her birthday. But what begins as a day that Sour has always dreamed of quickly becomes a disappointment when she misses her twin. With Strawberry's help, Sour gives her birthday back to Sweet with a special surprise.
When a comedy of errors causes Orange, Plum and Cherry to arrive late to their campout, they start off their annual tradition of telling tall-tales around the campfire.

At the girls' campout, Sour launches into a whopper of a yarn about the adventures she and Sweet had in the "Berry Deep Dark Forest." She tries to get Sweet to participate in spinning the tale, but Sour's over-the-top performance leaves Sweet behind. Toward the end, Sour graciously changes the story to pull Sweet into it, giving Sweet the opportunity to toss in an ad lib that makes a nice topper to Sour's story.

Apple isn't paying attention when Strawberry describes their campout tradition of telling "Tall Tales." So Apple tells her thrilling adventure of a wild road rally she entered, only to surprise the girls by proving the story is actually true.

Apple's rave review on her berryweb page of Strawberry's new dessert starts a booming mail order dessert business for Berry Bitty City. When Strawberry's stuffed-up nose makes her bake a bad-tasting cake, Apple, afraid the truth will hurt Strawberry's reputation, proclaims it's delicious. The fib snowballs when the Queen of Berryvania reads Apple's review and orders Strawberry's new cake for her ball.

Sour teasing Apple escalates into a "prank war" between the two of them. After the girls' feud disrupts the town, they are sentenced in a Berry Bitty City-style trial to camp alone together for a whole weekend. Miraculously, they emerge best buds, and their friends are relieved, until Sour's influence on Apple turns her into a mini-Sour, and they have to do a personality "makeover" on Apple.
Berrykin Bloom's braggart cousin, Berrykin Bertram, has won the hot sauce competition at the local county fair year after year.

When Apple feels left out of a Berryball game and an advanced ballet class, she invents some "groove booties" programmed to dance to any beat. She temporarily impresses her friends with her dance moves, but when the groove booties go out of control and threaten the town's Berryball game, she is forced to fess up.

Stu and Didi take Tommy and Angelica on a car trip to the Grand Canyon./Tommy and Chuckie accidentally toss their glider plane into the scary basement.
Tommy and Chuckie accidentally are left in a huge toy store after closing.   After Grandpa reads them a pirate story, Tommy, Chuck, Phil and Lil imagine that they're buccaneers on the high seas.

programmes.st: Chuckie versus the Potty / Together at Last
programmes.d: When Chuckie spends a weekend at the Pickles house, he tells Tommy that his father is trying to potty train him.   When Phil and Lil get in a fight over a toy, Betty separates them by sending Lil to Tommy's while Phil stays at home.

Tommy gets put in a new-age care center that seems an awful lot like a prison.   When Tommy has to go to the doctor to get a rooster shot, he and another baby try to make an escape, wreaking havoc through the hospital.

Tommy and Chuck go to a new playground where the peace-loving kids live in fear of a bully called 'the junk-food kid'.   Didi brings a strange mirror home from an antique store. Tommy and Chuckie learn that there is a 'mirrorland' on the other side.

programmes.st: Doug Throws A Party/Doug Way Out West
programmes.d: Doug is having his first house party, and he is very nervous about it--especially when he sees how his parents decorated the place. When Skeeter exaggerates about Doug's horsemanship, Doug goes along with it--until Roger challenges his story.

Doug and his friends are graduating from the Bluffington School, and Doug feels a bit melancholy. The Funnies are driving across country to visit the Great Painted Gorge. Doug and Judy convince Phil to stop at several tourist traps along the way.

Ickis is accidentally thrown through the air by a bulldozer and inadvertently saves a group of students./A substitute teacher arrives, announcing that The Gromble has "gone away" and that he will be taking over.

programmes.st: The Great Escape / Beast with Four Eyes
programmes.d: Shortly McGinty escapes from prison and leads the police on a chase that takes him to the dump, where the cops mistake Ickis for McGinty and haul him off to prison.

programmes.st: Side by Side / Hooked on Phobics
programmes.d: The Gromble assigns Ickis to be "pair-scare" partners with the dreaded, unpopular Zimbo. Ickis and Zimbo are miserable with the match and instantly start bickering./Ickis discovers as easy way out of getting his homework done.
A visit from their country cousin, who looks and acts like a real beaver, annoys Dag but prompts Norb to go back to nature. When he finds out he won't have to take baths anymore, Dag follows.

The boys take a voyage to the bottom of the pond in their own Beaver-rigged submarine, the Norbalus. / A family of freeloading otters moves in on the boys, turns their lives upside down and threatens to take over their dam.
The kids and their parents are at Camp Everwood. Chance, a camp counselor, is staging an elaborate musical while Dil is discovering whether or not the camp is haunted.
The kids take an aptitude test to get a clue as to what they want to be when they grow up, but they are not thrilled about the results.
Charlotte lets Angelica redesign her room. The first step: throwing out all the toys. Unfortunately, that also includes Cynthia, Angelica's favorite doll.
An older girl, Francine, picks on Tommy. And Angelica loves every minute of it! Is it possible that Francine likes Tommy, or is she just a pest?
Kimi becomes obsessed with her Japanese heritage when she and the gang have to research their family trees as a school project.

Angelica's been invited to Savannah's party so she has to find a dress that hasn't ABW (Already Been Worn). While working at the hospital she suddenly breaks her nose and fakes a dilemma. Meanwhile the other kids are doing community service.
Susie is forced to choose between singing success in a TV talent show and leading her language team to victory in the language bowl, which is held on the same day.

When Chuckie's biggest competition for School Safety Commissioner is Dil's imaginary alien friend, Izzy, you would think he would have it in the bag. But when Izzy becomes more popular than Chuckie, can he rely on his friends to help him win?

The guys are visited by their hometown friend who happens to be an awesome singer, but also the world’s biggest klutz! At the same time, James is visited by a fan whose behavior quickly turns from complimentary to stalker.

James helps Camille run lines for an audition and they end up kissing! Meanwhile, Gustavo tries to set up Carlos with his first girlfriend, and Kendall and Jo try to balance their hectic schedules so they can see each other.
The boys are scheduled to make their first TV appearance, but when it looks like BTR will be bumped from the line-up, they do whatever it takes to make their debut happen.

It’s Halloween in Palm Woodsylvania and the monstrous personas of Big Time Rush come to light. James is a sexy vampire, Logan is a zombie who keeps losing his limbs, Carlos is Franken-Carlos, and Kendall is a werewolf.
Jo’s publicist wants the press to think she’s dating her new co-star, so Kendall and Jo must sneak around and hide their relationship!
The annual Day of Pranks competition at the Palm Woods has arrived and soon a boys vs. girls prank war begins!

Gustavo gets a spiritual guru to help with his anger issues, but when the guru talks Gustavo into letting him run Rocque Records, the boys must do whatever it takes to get back control of Big Time Rush.
When the parents leave town for the weekend, Drake and Josh's excitement is stunted when they learn that Grammy is coming to stay.
Drake bets that he can last longer without junk food than Josh can without video games. Who will win.
Drake receives tickets to a concert and a guitar autographed by his idol. Josh accidentally destroys the guitar and to cover it up has to buy a new one.
Josh and Drake both get a job at the Movie Theater and works toward the coveted assistant manager position.
Drake convinces Josh that in order to become cooler he must try out for the football team.
Drake takes advantage of Josh's billiard skills by hustling local kids and swindling them out of their money.

True Jackson has a passion for fashion. She gets the chance of a lifetime when she's hired as the VP for a major fashion label.  The problem? Her new coworkers are not too thrilled to have a 15 year old as their boss.
Max enlists the help of True, Ryan, and Lulu to propose to his girlfriend, Doris, who is expecting something original.
In an effort to build understanding of what everyone does, Max assigns the staff to do a different job for the day.

Kenan's parents are celebrating their 17th wedding anniversary.  Roger really wants to impress Sheryl, so he visits a friend who owns a jewelry store.
Kel has the worst case of the flu.  Kenan tries to cure him with a homemade remedy consisting of just about everything in the kitchen.
The President of the United States makes a visit to Rigby's during a stop in Chicago.  While walking through the store, he falls prey to a toppling display of orange soda cans the boys have erected.

It's love at first sight when Kenan meets the daughter of his father's boss, Mr. Dawson.  But when the answering machine records more than just him hanging up, Kenan and Kel set out to switch the tape.
Kenan has been saving up all year to buy a Christmas present for himself. To get the last few dollars he needs, he accepts a job as a department store Santa.
The guys are excited to head back to Minnesota for the holidays, but Gustavo’s got them working on a Christmas EP, and won’t let them go home until it’s done.

The guys are excited to head back to Minnesota for the holidays, but Gustavo tells them they have to stay in LA to record a three-song Christmas EP, and it looks like they'll be spending their first Christmas away from home.
Determined to get more involved with the recording process the boys compete to write a new song for BTR.

Kendall and Jo help Carlos find a date, and Logan flirts with a new girl while still confused about his feelings for Camille. James wants to help Katie get closer to her new crush, but becomes like an overprotective father.
Private Parts follows Howard Stern’s amazing transformation from school nerd to media superstar.

The year is 1972, and Betsy Jobs and Arlene Lorenzo just want to have a good time. But during a class field trip to the White House, they cluelessly wander into a behind-closed-doors, top-secret shredding session. Rating: PG-13

Reese Witherspoon plays Tracy Flick, a straight-A go-getter determined to be president of Carver High’s student body. Popular teacher Jim McAllister (Broderick) decides to derail Tracy’s obsessive overachieving by recruiting an opposition candidate.

When the models arrive in China they are introduced to their new penthouse suite, and one model who is left without a place to sleep becomes very upset.

programmes.st: The Girls Go On Go-See Adventures
programmes.d: The remaining five models are sent on designer go-sees in Shanghai.  Some girls get the designers’ praise while others do not impress and one model loses her way.

programmes.st: The Girls Go To The Great Wall
programmes.d: The girls learn some Chinese history from J. Alexander and Twiggy and move into their new Beijing home.

programmes.st: The Girl Who Becomes America’s Next Top Model
programmes.d: The final three use all things they’ve learned up to this point in the competition for the penultimate shoot; a commercial and national print ad for Cover Girl.
In the cycle 10 premiere, 30 girls enter Top Model Prep with instructors Jay Manuel and J. Alexander and quickly begin their modeling education.

programmes.st: New York City, Here We Come
programmes.d: The girls check out their new apartment in New York City and admire the humanitarian theme behind this year’s loft.
Elle Macpherson surprises the girls at a photo shoot and they model her new lingerie line after getting makeovers.
The models are called to duty with Miss J and the New York City Fire Department where the girls strut their stuff and show off their quick-change skills.

programmes.st: Top Model Takes It To The Streets
programmes.d: Benny Ninja, famous for his posing skills, teams up with supermodel Vendela to teach the girls the different stances for catalog, commercial and couture shoots by pitting them against each other in a posing battle on the streets of New York.
Tyra surprises the girls in a dance studio and teaches them how to work their fierceness while posing at the end of a runway.

programmes.st: If You Can't Make It Here, You Can't Make It Anywhere
programmes.d: The models are spilt into two teams for go-sees with Shoshanna Lonstein, Pamella Roland and Stacey Bendit from Alice & Olivia.

A look at never-before-seen footage of the cycle 10 contestants that includes the ladies battling with posing instructor Benny Ninja and his team, New York City firefighters practicing their runway struts and contestant wrestling matches.

programmes.st: For Those About To Walk, We Salute You
programmes.d: Paulina drops by the loft to surprise the girls with tips on how to behave during press interviews and while attending public events.
The models head to Rome for the second part of the competition and are thrilled with their new home.
The models embrace their inner warriors when they learn gladiator-style fighting, complete with swords.
The final four models step behind the camera during this week’s challenge when they get to photograph Paulina Porizkova and later pose as famous movie icons in a shoot with photographer Nigel Barker.

When Rommie becomes too emotional, the ship cuts her access in order to run diagnostics. This leaves the ship vulnerable to a Magog attack.
The Abyss kills Beka's friend, and the crew must figure out what information they killed for.
Andromeda rescues a ship returning from peace talks with the Magog. An attack is coming.
The Magog attack has dire consequences. The Andromeda is destroyed, Trance and Dylan are presumed the only survivors, and Dylan escapes into the Route of Ages.
Dylan ends up on Seefra, where the superstitious population has no technology. Rhade is there, none too happy to see Dylan.
Beka is dumped on Seefra after the Andromeda is stolen, and Dylan must prove the ship is his.
Still, on Seefra, Dylan finds Harper, who has adjusted to life there, and the mysterious Doyle.
It turns out Doyle is an android, built by Harper to contain Rommie's core programming. During a battle with androids from the future, a way out of Seefra is destroyed.
Beka wins a prize from a radio DJ, learns the truth about Seefra, and locates the Meethus Diagram - but has no idea what it does.
A scientist from the original Commonwealth shows up, caught in a time loop.
Flavin returns, sparking a gang war, and helps Dylan develop as a Paradine.
A crystal that can restore the Andromeda's power is discovered, but in order to get it, Dylan must work for the mine's owner - who uses slave labor.
Tunnels are discovered on Seefra which can be used to reach eight other Seefra planets.
When an old man is killed, Beka, Rhade, and Harper are the main suspects and stand trial.
Rhade leads the rebels in a battle against a warlord on Seefra-5. A scientist previously thought dead helps Harper rebuild the quantum teleporter.
Dylan discovers that Beka's boyfriend was really Drago Musevini, and he used Beka's DNA to create the Nietzscheans. She is their Alpha Matriarch.
Beka and Rhade find a test that will either grant them great wealth or drive them to madness.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Chili Pepper, Part 1
programmes.d: Chili Pepper suddenly appears before Josuke to test his Stand powers. Josuke puts up a fight but is overwhelmed by Chili Pepper’s power. The next day, Josuke and friends learn from Jotaro that a man who can locate Chili Pepper is heading to Morioh

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Chili Pepper, Part 2
programmes.d: Josuke and his friends gather at the Port to try and reach Joseph Joestar before Chili Pepper. Speculating the enemy is hiding nearby, Jotaro orders Josuke and Koichi to stay behind and find Chili Pepper’s user while he and Okuyasu go protect Joseph.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: We Picked Up Something Crazy!
programmes.d: With Akira Otoishi arrested and the bow and arrow safely recovered, peace seemingly returns to Morioh. But Josuke’s life is far from peaceful as he struggles to deal with his father, whose old age is making things difficult for them to bond.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Let's Go to the Manga Artist's House, Part 1
programmes.st: Let's Go to the Manga Artist's House, Part 1
programmes.d: Koichi and Hazamada visit the home of Rohan Kishibe, a popular manga artist whom they are huge fans of. Much to their joy, Rohan not only agrees to sign autographs but also invites them to take a tour of his workspace.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Let's Go to the Manga Artist's House, Part 2
programmes.st: Let's Go to the Manga Artist's House, Part 2
programmes.d: Koichi is drawn back to Rohan’s house, where he sees the manga artist finishing up his next manga at an incredible speed. Rohan uses his stand Heaven’s Door on Koichi again to gain further creative inspiration from the young boy’s life experience.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Let's Go Hunting!
programmes.d: Jotaro and Josuke must hunt down a rat that is believed to have become a Stand user after being shot by the bow and arrow. When the two arrive at the site, they find dozens of dead rats killed in the most bizarre fashion.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Rohan Kishibe's Adventure
programmes.d: Koichi and Rohan discover a small alley that does not appear to be listed anywhere on the map. The two decide to go into the alley to see where it leads but soon find themselves walking around in circles and unable to get out.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Shigechi's Harvest, Part 1
programmes.d: Josuke and Okuyasu become friends with a Stand user named Shigekiyo Yangu, a.k.a. Shigechi, who can use his Stand to find and collect the money that is scattered across town. Impressed by the boy’s abilities.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Shigechi's Harvest, Part 2
programmes.d: Josuke and friends try to cash in the winning lottery ticket they found. However, the bank clerk is not convinced they’re the actual owners of the ticket, placing the three teens into a tough spot as they try to talk their way through their big lie.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Yukako Yamagishi Dreams of Cinderella
programmes.d: Yukako, depressed because she can’t get Koichi to return her feelings, comes across a beauty salon where the owner claims a special beauty treatment will help customers find love and happiness…

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Yoshikage Kira Just Wants to Live Quietly, Part 1
programmes.st: Yoshikage Kira Just Wants to Live Quietly, Part 1
programmes.d: A man named Yoshikage Kira is enjoying his lunch break at the park with a sandwich in hand. But his peaceful afternoon is cut short when Shigechi accidentally takes Kira’s sandwich bag, believing it to be his own.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Yoshikage Kira Just Wants to Live Quietly, Part 2
programmes.st: Yoshikage Kira Just Wants to Live Quietly, Part 2
programmes.d: Yoshikage Kira is revealed to be the serial killer who’s been lurking in Morioh, and a Stand user as well. Having discovered his secret, Shigechi tries to fight off Kira with his Harvest, only to suffer fatal wounds from the killer’s Stand, Deadly Queen

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Heart Attack, Part 1
programmes.d: Jotaro and Koichi come under the attack of Yoshikage Kira’s Stand bomb, called Heart Attack. Narrowly escaping the blast, Koichi tries to go after the serial killer but is stopped by Jotaro, who tells him to focus on dealing with the Stand bomb first.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Heart Attack, Part 2
programmes.d: Kira is forced to appear before Koichi after his remote Heart Attack bomb is made useless by the boy’s new Stand, Reverb Act 3. Finally coming face-to-face with the serial killer, Koichi attacks him with Act 3.
Josuke and his friends are at Yoshikage Kira’s home trying to find any clues that may lead them to the serial killer, who has gone into hiding under a new face and identity.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Janken Boy Is Coming!
programmes.d: Kira’s father, Yoshihiro, begins searching for Stand users who would help protect his son from his pursuers. Meanwhile, Rohan is taking photos at the train station when he is suddenly challenged to a game of rock-paper-scissors.
Saitama's a guy who’s a hero out of boredom. After saving a child from certain death, he decided to become a hero and trained hard for three years to become 'One Punch Man.'
A monster is moving toward City Z, one created by the mysterious organization known as 'The House of Evolution.'

Yuki and Zero are busy dealing with the Day Class students who are chasing after the Night Class students more fervently than ever due to the upcoming dance…
To prepare for the upcoming exam, Zero tutors Yuki, but all the while, she notices something wrong with him. Meanwhile, at the Moon Dormitory, Kaname confronts Maria in his room…
Maria’s masked servant is none other than Zero’s twin brother, Ichiru, whom Zero has not seen since their separation long ago…
Yuki learns that Maria’s true identity is Shizuka, the pureblood vampire who bit Zero and turned him into a vampire.

programmes.t: Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead (English Dubbed)

programmes.st: James Braxton and Izzie Balmer, Day 2
programmes.d: Izzie Balmer and James Braxton travel through Wales and Shropshire. Izzie springs for an 18th century oak coffer and an 1832 sampler. James has high hopes for 1911 silver scallop shell butter dishes and an Edwardian mahogany table.

programmes.st: James Braxton and Izzie Balmer, Day 3
programmes.d: In northern Wales, James Braxton buys yet more bamboo, this time in the form of a jardiniere stand. Izzie Balmer picks up a novelty money box shaped like a pigeon, but her biggest purchase is a 19th century tramp art box.

programmes.st: James Braxton and Izzie Balmer, Day 4
programmes.d: James Braxton and Izzie Balmer hunt for antiques in Snowdonia National Park in Wales, and find scent bottles, brick molds and cloisonne bowls. They also learn about a revolutionary Welsh king and befriend an iconic and "beefy" local.

programmes.st: James Braxton and Izzie Balmer, Day 5
programmes.d: It's James Braxton and Izzie Balmer's last day in Wales, and Izzie strikes gold, finding a bangle, pendant and earrings. James accumulates a hoard of shiny items – and one piece of silver causes a shock at auction.

programmes.st: Margie Cooper and Ochuko Ojiri, Day 1
programmes.d: Margie Cooper and Ochuko Ojiri set off on a northwest antiques hunt in a vintage Jaguar. A 1940s fairground collectible takes bidders for a ride while a silver egg cup has a royal connection.

programmes.st: Margie Cooper and Ochuko Ojiri, Day 2
programmes.d: Margie Cooper and Ochuko Ojiri visit Staffordshire, via the Trent and Mersey Canal. Railwayana puts one expert on track for profits while the other hopes a birdcage will fly at auction.

programmes.st: Margie Cooper and Ochuko Ojiri, Day 3
programmes.d: Along the Welsh border, Margie Cooper hopes for big profits from a Victorian oak barrel, while Ochuko Ojiri is stirred by Sheffield silver and is left shaken at auction.

programmes.st: Margie Cooper and Ochuko Ojiri, Day 4
programmes.d: Margie Cooper and Ochuko Ojiri head to Worcestershire in their quest for big profits. Margie learns about Victorian kitchen gadgets -- could she make it as a maid? And Ochuko is drawn to a piece of 1970s modern art.

programmes.st: Margie Cooper and Ochuko Ojiri, Day 5
programmes.d: In Wiltshire, Ochuko Ojiri spies a trunk filled with silver and tries to buy the lot, while Margie Cooper purchases an Edwardian shoe sign and an early 20th century mbira. Who will make the most cash at the final auction?

programmes.st: Catherine Southon and David Harper, Day 1
programmes.d: Starting off in Kent in a 1960s Citroean 2CV, it's a feisty reunion in Kent for veteran Road Trippers Catherine Southon and David Harper as they discover that ten years apart hasn't dulled their competitive edge.

programmes.st: Catherine Southon and David Harper, Day 2
programmes.d: Catherine Southon and David Harper call on a doggy antique appraiser as they travel along the Sussex coast. David gets into trouble playing cricket in a shop full of china and Catherine hunts for items with an aeronautical theme.

programmes.st: Catherine Southon and David Harper, Day 3
programmes.d: Catherine Southon and David Harper are on the Isle of Wight and around Hampshire. David goes for Dutch dishes, while Catherine finds a Scottish Wemyss ware jar. Plus, how homesick French WWII sailors helped introduce garlic to the area.

programmes.st: Catherine Southon and David Harper, Day 4
programmes.d: David Harper and Catherine Southon go digging for bargains on the Jurassic Coast. Catherine is attracted to an old clothes rail while David goes for another piece of Delft. And the auction is watched from a former courtroom!

programmes.st: Catherine Southon and David Harper, Day 5
programmes.d: Catherine Southon and David Harper are on their last leg in Devon heading to the final auction in Leicestershire, and their jaunt affords them lots of places to unearth things with an interesting past.

programmes.st: Irita Marriott and Mark Hill, Day 1
programmes.d: Irita Marriott and Mark Hill set out in a sky blue 1967 Triumph Herald for their first trip together, hunting for antiques to sell at auction. Irita spends big on her beloved porcelain while Mark invests in mid-century Italian ceramics.

programmes.st: Irita Marriott and Mark Hill, Day 2
programmes.d: Irita Marriott and Mark Hill continue their search for money making treasures. Some Victorian anatomy molds and a 200-year-old Regency ornament go under the gavel.

programmes.st: Irita Marriott and Mark Hill, Day 3
programmes.d: Irita Marriott and Mark Hill cruise around East Anglia on a search for treasures from a bygone era, and find a rare blue duck, sought-after Hungarian porcelain, a penny farthing and some pretty earrings.

The crew calls Sky out for her behavior in Korea. Nikki drops a bomb on O'Sh**t. Bae is shocked by Rob's reaction to the news that she's pregnant. And Ceaser and Kitty rekindle their romance, while Jadah attempts to play matchmaker for Walt.

O'S**t rushes to Atlanta for the birth of his fourth child. Sky freaks out when Ceaser contacts her son, Genesis. Bae wants a shotgun wedding, but Rob has other plans. And Ceaser has an emotional meeting with Sky's son.

Melody meets her father's estranged family for the first time while the rest of the crew heads to the slopes. Ceaser plans some grand romantic gestures for Kitty. Sky loses her cool when Teddy hooks up with a fellow Black Ink employee.

The crew turns up at Bae's bachelorette party. Sky spreads a rumor about Jadah.  Donna is in hot water after Alex posts a scandalous video. Sky attempts to repair her relationship with the son she gave up for adoption 15 years ago.

Is someone out to assassinate the Commissioner or was the shooting random? Danny takes on the assignment to find out the answer.
Nicky rides along with Danny to a crime scene where a girl at a debutante ball has been murdered and she has a difficult time coping after seeing her first murder victim.
As a former Marine, Danny feels personally responsible for finding the killer of a former U.S. Marine war hero. Someone has leaked false information to the press that Frank is going to run for mayor.
Just before Danny is to give witness testimony at a Peruvian drug lord's murder trial, Linda is kidnapped. This drug lord has a history of intimidating witnesses.
Danny and Jackie investigate the cut-throat world of fashion after Linda's runway model niece and a reporter are poisoned at a fashion show.
Frank's frustrations rise when the media sensationalizes the murder of a tourist shot and killed outside a trendy Lower East Side restaurant.
Neighbors of the Reagans are murdered and their son becomes the prime suspect. Jamie is convinced he's being pursued by the Blue Templar when his gun goes missing.
When a drug bust points to dirty cops, Frank decides not to involve Internal Affairs in the hopes of taking down and exposing the Blue Templar.
When a supporter for the mayor elect is found dead, Frank is put on the spot when the mayor wants him to position it to the public as a random act of violence.
When Danny shoots a cop who failed to identify himself, he is put on modified assignment and must face an Internal Affairs investigation, which delves into his personal state of mind that day.
When three men attempt to rob a bank, Danny discovers that one of the perps happens to be a former cop.

Erin reopens an 18-year-old rape case, in which Frank was the arresting officer. Meanwhile, Danny and Jackie investigate the murder of three teenagers in a park, who seemed to have been killed for no reason.
Danny tries to juggle investigating a case while trying to have a romantic weekend with Linda.
Frank deals with a political crisis after Jamie and Renzulli enter a religious center in response to a 911 call and are injured by the church's security team who prohibits them from entering.
Jackie goes undercover as an escort when she and Danny track down a serial killer who is murdering prostitutes in hotel rooms.
When Erin's informant is murdered, she blames herself and works to help Danny discover who killed him.
When a young woman commits suicide, Danny and Jackie suspect it was forced.
Ben helps a convict win a parole only to have the man later become the chief suspect in a bank robbery.
Adam sets out to track down the man who has been impersonating him to clear his reputation.
Joe becomes romantically involved with a woman who considers herself a serious dramatic actress.  Unfortunately, she is the only one who does.
Ben assists Georgio Rossi in his battle for water on adjoining property.
In this entertaining episode, laced with humor, Hoss first meets mountain man Jim Leyton.  Bing Russell makes his first appearance as Deputy Clem Foster.
With a storm brewing, Adam takes refuge at a way station, run by cantankerous Jesse and his young grandaughter Marty, who yearns to see what exists away from the way station.
Adam and Laura are finally engaged.  Adam is secretly building a house and planning for the future. Laura realizes that it's Will she is in love with.
Moody bounty hunter, Dev Farnum, shows up on the Ponderosa, where the Cartwrights are harboring the wife of the man he is after.
An Indian-hating officer, Colonel Edward J. Dunwoody, comes to the Ponderosa looking for army deserter Bill Winters, who is a good friend of the Cartwrights.

Ben's friend, Don Miguel, visits the Ponderosa with his two daughters, Margarita and Elena, and Elena's two very anxious suitors.  Their mission? They're on their way to California to meet Margarita's suitor, Don Luis.
The Ponderosa becomes a war zone when it is invaded by a detachment of Mexican mercenaries under General Diaz.
The Civil War once again divides the citizens of Nevada, as well as Adam and Joe Cartwright.  One of season four's highlights, the plot involving British spy Bill Stewart, based on historical fact.
Hoss becomes concerned for the welfare of an insecure, belligerent fellow who is as small as Hoss is large.  Interesting blend of comedy and pathos that ends unpredictably.
Billy Horne is a white man who was captured by the Shoshone when he was six. He comes into Ben & Joe's campsite one night uninvited.
Claude Miller, the laughingstock of Virginia City, gets even with everyone who made fun of him when he strikes it rich.
Hoss is seriously injured internally and Ben seeks help from the only doctor within 50 miles, who happens to be in prison for murder.
Joe becomes fascinated by detective literature and drags Hoss into the picture when he suspects the bank is going to be robbed.
Exam day is fast approaching, and everyone at the Academy begins preparing for them. Repeating a grade is a possibility if you fail a test.
Sarada agrees to return a teddy bear to a young patient at the hospital, but she forgets it on the train and goes into a panic.

programmes.st: A Day in The Life of the Uzumaki Family
programmes.d: The Uzumaki household is thrown into chaos when Himawari, Boruto's younger sister, catches a cold.

Boruto pulls a prank and is pursued around the village by Naruto. Seeing this, Sarada can't help but be exasperated, but a part of her grows wistful as she thinks of her father, Sasuke, whom she hasn't seen since she was a baby.
Sarada, who has doubts about who her real mother is, joins Cho-Cho, who is about to set out on a journey to find her ¿real parents?
Sarada arrives at the tower where her father is, only to be hurt by Sasuke's surprising words and actions.
Sarada is in shock after Sakura is captured by Shin's jutsu. Even Naruto, with his exceptional tracking skills, is unable to locate her.
Determined to rescue Sakura, Sarada pursues Shin with Sasuke, Naruto, and Cho-Cho.
The Hidden Leaf Village is filled with excitement upon the arrival of the Kage for the Five Kage Summit.
Boruto and his classmates head to the Village Hidden in the Mist in the Land of Water for a field trip.
Boruto and his classmates are invited to tour the Hidden Mist Academy under Kagura and Chojuro's escort.
Tsurushi Hachiya, Kagura's former classmate at the Academy, finds Boruto and his friends from the Leaf irritating, so he kidnaps Denki.
Kagura unwittingly becomes part of a plot set up by Shizuma Hoshigaki, a man who opposes the new, peaceful shinobi order.
The New Seven Ninja Swordsmen begin an insurrection, the end goal being to turn their village back into the Blood Mist Village!

programmes.st: The Sharingan vs. The Lightning Blade, Kiba the Fang!
programmes.d: Sarada is forced into one-on-one combat with a kunoichi, Buntan Kurosuki, who wields the Lightning Blade, Kiba the Fang! In the thick fog, Sarada uses her Sharingan, but her enemy is stronger than expected
Boruto urges his friend Kagura to return with him, but Kagura rejects him and begins to attack.
The field trip comes to an end, and Boruto and his friends prepare to return to Hidden Leaf. Chojuro, the Mizukage, sees them off, but Kagura is nowhere to be seen.
Inojin has loved to draw since he was small, and his ninjutsu speciality is the Super Beast Scroll. But one day, he suddenly loses his ability to use his jutsu!

programmes.st: The Night of the Shooting Stars
programmes.d: Boruto and his classmates decide to go camping to try to catch the mysterious fish, the Eternal Carp, said to be unforgettably delicious.
As the students prepare for their finals, Boruto meets a journalist named Sukea who is doing a story on them.

Boruto and the others complete the first-round written exam and move on to the next. The second round has the students facing off against Kakashi and the academy instructors in actual combat situations.
Boruto's the first to confront Kakashi in the exam. Despite a determined effort, he is immobilized and angered by Kakashi's severe criticism of his class.
Boruto and his classmates take their first step as genin and start forming their basic shinobi three-man squads.

programmes.st: The Path Lit by the Full Moon
programmes.d: Mitsuki faces a difficult decision, but his thoughts and feelings that had once been shrouded in mystery, now come to light.
Team 7 sets out on their first mission.
Team 7's original mission evolves into a rescue operation after Kiri is kidnapped.
Team 7 is assigned to capture a suspect who has barricaded himself inside a bank.
An incident occurs in Hidden Leaf Village and the Byakuya Gang is suspected.
Sasuke appears before Naruto to warn him of impending danger. An inconceivable foe lies in wait as Sasuke, the Five Kage and Boruto, charge into another dimension!
Boruto Uzumaki, the son of the village leader, saves a boy named Denki Kaminarimon, who's being picked on by bullies.

While Amanda Bentley visits Martin, a good friend, and benefactor of a visiting Communist Chinese dance troupe, Tako, the star dancer drops dead.
High-power and high-profile defense attorney, Roger Calendar, is brought into the emergency room with a near-fatal stabbing wound.

Calvin Laird, Mark and Steve's neighbor, threatens his girlfriend violently when she challenges his mean behavior. His repeated playing of loud music bothers the Sloans to no end.

No one recognizes the Doctor.
An engineer notes strange events.

The Doctor battles the Nestene consciousness.

A widow's retriever mix and two fox terriers do not get along; a Shar-Pei/Doberman mix drools excessively on car rides; Cesar revisits a Rottweiler mix.
After a 45-day stint in Iraq and two hurricanes, an explosive-sniffing ATF Labrador retriever begins exhibiting severe symptoms of terror.
An Italian greyhound mix is possessive over bones and toys; a mastiff misbehaves outside; a Yorkshire terrier takes over her owner's morning routine.

An unpredictably aggressive Kerry blue terrier; two territorial Maltese dogs who are close to being banned from the retirement home where they live; a bloodhound/Catahoula mix who attacks her canine companion.
Cesar visits Tijuana, Mexico, to team up with volunteers from United Hope for Animals, an organization that rescues dogs and finds them U.S. homes; a cocker spaniel taunts her owner.
A golden retriever mix with canine aggression; a bearded collie who barks, howls and scratches at her owner's boyfriend's guitar; a Lhasa apso/Cavalier King Charles Spaniel with canine aggression.
Cesar tries to restore peace at an apartment complex where the residents' dogs do not get along; a family has trouble controlling its three dogs.
An American Eskimo dog attacks doors and windows whenever people pass; a Shiba Inu overprotects his corgi playmate; two bulldogs are aggressive.

Everyone's getting ready for the big Thanksgiving Day parade and dinner, but the Pirate Piggies accidentally float away on Dora's boat float.

Dora's on her way to the doctor's for her yearly check up!  Dora likes going to see Dr. Valds because she gets to hear her heartbeat, see how much she's grown in one year and get a new sticker at the end of the visit!

Map has been teaching his nephew, Little Map, how to draw pictures that help us on our adventures, and today he's ready for his first treasure adventure! We help Little Map draw pictures and play map games to find the treasure at Treasure Mountain!
Dora and Boots take Baby Bongo on a musical adventure as they race to the Big Music Show in time for Baby Bongo's first performance.
Dora and Isa have been learning how the Earth's natural energy can power things we use every day. So they've made a volcano for the Science Fair!
Dora and Boots are at the beach when they find finda little lost mermaid who needs to get back to her mommy at Mermaid Cove. Together the 3 set off on an underwater adventure!
Dora and Boots discover Pincel, a cute little paintbrush who's lost and really wants to get back to Painter Daniella at the Art Studio.
Today's Benny's Sing-Along Party is where Dora and Benny are going to sing a very special song together! C'mon, let's all sing-along!
Dora and Boots take a rainbow butterfly, a mariposa, to the Butterfly Ball, where everybody gets to have wings.

programmes.st: Dora and Diego's Amazing Animal Circus Adventure
programmes.d: Dora and her cousin Diego are on their way to a big surprise. It's Boots and Baby Jaguar's Amazing Animal Circus!
Dora and Boots become book explorers and enter the worlds of Peter Pan, the Wizard of Oz, and Little Red Riding Hood so they can find missing objects for the library's Story Wall.
While Dora's kitties run through a magic mirror, Dora becomes Dora in Wonderland! Join her and Boots on a double-length adventure through the magical, mixed-up world of Wonderland!
Dora travels to Brazil to play in the Big Cup soccer tournament, and if her team can beat the Monsters, they'll win the Big Cup.
Dora, Boots, Benny, and a stroller full of rambunctious puppies rush to save their puppy friend, Little Boots, before he wakes up a bear.

Dora and Boots are making a shape train in his Boots' sticker book, but when the train goes rolling down the track without Círculo, the steering wheel, they need your help to catch it before it gets to Big Turn!
Dora, Boots, and Verde the clean-up truck need your help on an adventure to clear up a flood at Party Park in time for Verde's birthday party! ¡Vámonos!

programmes.st: Dora and Perrito to the Rescue
programmes.d: With her brave dog at her side, Dora races on her scooter to the Big River so they can rescue Boots.
Dora, Boots, and Abuela are exploring the rainforest looking for the secret door to Adventure Forest! It's a magical forest amusement park that Abuela used to go to when she was a little girl!
Dora is reading a book of nursery rhymes to Abuela's kitty, Lucky. Lucky loves the one about the three little kittens who ring the bells on their mittens as they dance and sing!
Dora and Boots put on their roller skates and take off on a skating adventure to stand up to a bully named Big Wheeler and open the Skate Park for everyone.
After helping Sparky the horse feel better, Dora goes on one more ride with him before bringing him back to the barn.
Dora takes a magic cape back to the prince's castle so she can break the spell that turned the prince into a lion.
Dora and Boots return to the Snowy Forest to help the Snow Princess defeat the Ice Witch in a skating contest and win back everyone's ice skates.
It's time for the Rainforest Talent Show, but first Dora and Boots have to rescue Benny so he can tell his jokes in the show.

programmes.st: Dora and Diego in the Time of Dinosaurs
programmes.d: Dora and Diego travel back to prehistoric times and go on a dinosaur adventure to find Baby Jaguar and bring him home to his birthday party.

programmes.st: Dora and the Very Sleepy Bear
programmes.d: Dora and Boots try to keep a very sleepy Baby Bear awake long enough to get her home for her winter nap.
Dora, Emma, and Kate help Gus the bus take all of the instruments to the kids at music school.
Dora and Boots need to help the Fairy Godmother fix her magic wand, so she can get her puppy back!
Dora, Boots, and Diego set out to rescue their bunny, turtle and butterfly animalito friends and bring them back home to their Copal Tree.
Dora and Boots rush to take Dora's Night Light to the Library before it gets too dark for the little chickens' special story time.
Dora and Boots journey deep into the Never-to-be-Seen-Again Forest so they can bring magic water back from Sparkling Lake and save the magic in Fairytale Land.
Dora and Boots read about a chicken that's as big as a house and set off to meet him.
Dora and Boots find a little baby blue bird who fell out of her nest.
Prejudice comes to Colorado Springs as Dr. Mike and Sully try to help a young Latin-American woman when her husband is killed.
Dr. Mike is faced with the prospect of leaving Colorado Springs when Sully is offered a job surveying the new Yellowstone National Park.
Jake and Preston each want Dr. Mike’s endorsement when they run against one another for mayor -- until she is arrested.
Dr. Mike tries to reunite a father and son before it's too late.
Dr. Mike, Sully and Matthew join forces with a legendary marshal to track down the outlaws who wounded Matthew during a robbery.
Colorado Springs prepares for Thanksgiving, unaware of a deadly approaching storm that could destroy the town.
Dr. Mike, Sully and Brian must deal with the town’s prejudice when a black child tries to attend the all-white school.
Dr. Mike’s patients begin dying mysteriously.
Brian suffers a crisis of faith when the Rev. Johnson is stricken with progressive blindness at Christmas time, despite the healing efforts of Dr. Mike.
When Sully opposes the building of a dam, he finds himself on the other side of the law and behind bars.
Dr. Mike's revered Uncle Theodore shocks her and Sully when he criticizes their parenting skills and offers to take Brian to Boston.
Dr. Mike sees that the marriage of Kid Cole and Sister Ruth is unraveling for no apparent reason.
Dr. Mike reminisces about her tumultuous career – the successes and the failures -- since living in Colorado Springs.

Blake secures the release of Krystle and Alexis, and the families return from Moldavia; Luke is buried; Rita's boyfriend Joel is anxious to help Sammy Jo further her scheme; Alexis is preoccupied with Galen's welfare; Fallon tells Miles she has amnesia.

Monica goes to work as a television producer to help a driven young reporter after she leaves the scene of a hit-and-run accident
Monica puts on a police uniform to save a cop whose drug habit will soon destroy him

A hard-boiled journalist with a grudge against God harasses the angels while they’re searching for a boy who sent god a message in a bottle
Andrew, the angel of death, becomes the object of desire at a celebrity bachelor auction
Monica and Tess go Hollywood to help the daughter of an old-time movie star come to terms with long-kept family secrets, on Touched By An Angel

programmes.t: Jackie Chan's Project A2 (A Gai Waak Juk Jaap)
programmes.d: Dragon Mao is assigned to lead the local police force but soon discovers that police corruption is running wild right under his nose. When he's framed for a jewelry robbery, Dragon Mao must fight to clear his name.

Action-packed and full of fun, set off on a wacky adventure with kung-fu fighting cousins Thomas and David whose simple life running a fast-food van in Spain is turned upside down by the beautiful pickpocket Sylvia.
Two New York cops, Billy Wong and Danny Garoni, head to Hong Kong after the daughter of a rich businessman is kidnapped by the drug lord, Mr. Ko.

programmes.t: Xia Ri Fu Xing aka Twinkle Twinkle Lucky Stars
programmes.d: The do-gooder Lucky Stars gang takes a well-deserved break in Thailand where they are told to contact an informant. Their vacation is cut short when the informant is murdered sending them back to Hong Kong to protect his girlfriend.

Jackie Chan ignites the big screen as the world's greatest secret agent, code name Condor. Sent to track down stolen Nazi gold, he is pursued by a ruthless band of treasure-hunting terrorists on a globe-spanning quest to reach the bounty first!

programmes.t: Operation Condor II: The Armour Of The Gods
programmes.d: Jackie Chan is a fortune hunter whose ex-girlfriend is kidnapped by an evil cult! Things kick into high gear when her fiancée, an old friend of Jackie’s, asks him for help in securing the kidnappers’ lone demand: the priceless Armor of The Gods!

Jackie Chan plays a shrewd cop who goes undercover with a team of mercenaries when a man he put away two years before commits a murder. The film features the great Sammo Hung as well as the terrific Tony Leung Ka Fai.

Jackie Chan, Michelle Yeoh, and Maggie Cheung lead an action-packed classic with jaw-dropping stunts, from leaping out a ten-story building onto an airborne helicopter to landing on top of a speeding train.
Extremely silly comedy about a self-indulgent private investigator who winds up on a cruise ship full of rich patrons, gorgeous women, murderous terrorists, and scarce food.

A Special Agent is assigned to protect a wealthy business magnate. However, when the businessman is kidnapped in a daring ambush, he teams up with a seasoned detective to crack the case. But soon he discovers the case isn't that simple.

'A Nut at the Opera': When stage hand Pinky accidentally puts the opera's star tenor out of commission and must take over the lead himself. 'Hamm-N-Eggz': Hamm and Eggz royally mess up the wedding of the obnoxious daughter of a Mafioso hit-man.

'Voodoo Man': When Voodoo Man's island is wiped out by a storm, he goes in search of the weatherman he believes is responsible. '7 Manly Men': When the toy in a box of cereal doesn't live up to its promise, the Manly Men confront the company owner.

'Driving Mr. Pink': Pinky calls a taxi to get to an urgent appointment, only to find that the taxi driver is the Voodoo Man. 'Ant & The Aardvark': The Aardvark just keeps trying to eat Ant, but a picnicking Rhino always seems to be in his way.

Itchy comes down with a cold and is unable to go out on assignment with Charlie. Charlie is forced to take Sasha along with him to recover a little girl's class notes. Charlie and Sasha have very different ways of working and their styles clash.

After a frightening incident on a Ferris Wheel as a young puppy, Itchy is convinced that he is a coward. To overcome his fears, he visits a hypnotist. Itchy discovers that he can take on the persona of 'Fearless Fido', a super hero dog.

Charlie is the Flea Bite Champion of the latest game craze, Kibbleland. His obsession with the game brings out a selfish streak in him and with Charlie distracted, Belladonna has a plan to trap Charlie inside an enchanted version of the game.

When Itchy's gullible fascination with UFOs becomes too much for him, Charlie stages a practical joke to 'cure' his friend of his obsession. But the joke backfires when Charlie ends up being the one who starts seeing aliens.
A werewolf hunter comes to the town of Wolverton. Scott and his family must find and warn Grandpa, who is hunting turkey in the woods.
Scott tries to earn money to pay for an electric guitar. He helps at his dad's shop, but finds raising money is a lot more difficult than he expected.
Scott and his family mysteriously become unable to control their wolf-outs and worry that the town monster, that has been covered in recent news reports, is actually them.

Scott's werewolf family comes to town for a family reunion. Scott's cousin, Eva, goes on a date with Mick, and it's Scott's responsibility to protect the family secret before it's revealed that Eva is a werewolf.
Sabrina is excited to visit Uncle Quigley in his lab while taking a field trip to the observatory.
Gem’s family has suddenly gone bankrupt and she is forced to stay with Sabrina.
It’s time for Sabrina’s wisdom teeth to come out. She doesn’t want to experience it the mortal way so she opts to have them removed magically.
When Harvey can’t make the wrestling team, Sabrina uses Dragon Spray to help him.
A dolphin at Sea World will only eat from Cleo’s hand and when she has to sneak out to feed him, everyone thinks she has a boyfriend.
A rainy day traps the girls inside. In an effort to play sick, the girls create a situation where their families become part of a dire medical emergency.
The full moon has come again, and the girls are taking every precaution they can imagine this time. It proves to be in vain, however, when Rikki falls under the spell.

Cleo and Kim are fighting like crazy and Cleo is pushed to breaking point. Then cousin Angela comes to stay and things just get worse. Cleo realises there are more challenging things than an annoying sister.
Verne is picked on by Borge and Lucrezia when they see him playing a handheld video game.
A nervous Verne flunks his compulsory Scootsoomer driving test because he's afraid of heights. But he manages to conquer his fear at the Centre of the Earth on a wild ride.

When Verne's techno-magic almost screws up a mission to the Centre of the Earth, Verne is humiliated and leaves the school. But Zarlak seizes the opportunity. Working through a magic artifact in Verne's backpack, he gives Verne evil powers.

UBOS and the kids return from an action packed chase in Rootopia, Center-earth, to find the school under a sleeping spell. They've saved a magical Rupunzel Plant from Zarlak and replant it in the school garden. However, there are bigger problems afoot.
Lewis enters the annual fishing derby. When Cleo sees him struggling, she decides to help him out with disastorous consequnces. Meanwhile, Rikki and Zane are trapped on a hotel balcony.

Zane thinks Miss Chatham holds the key to the sea monster. Emma needs a change so dyes her hair red. While Zane gets closer to the secret, he also gets closer to Rikki. Zane dives to Miss Chatham’s boat and sees a mermaid!

Emma and Cleo find out Zane and Rikki are an item and force her to choose – him or them. When Zane appears to side with Harrison over the Mako island development Rikki’s decision is clear. Now it’s Zane’s turn to make a choice…

The girls discover a necklace for sale identical to Miss Chatham’s. Miriam causes a stir by buying it – then throwing it in the water. Rikki faces a choice whether to take the necklace and reveal her mermaidness to Zane.
Lewis thinks he’s found a way to control the girl’s mermaidness. The school dance brings all our heroines' 'boy issues' to the surface.
The return of Dr. Denman means trouble for the girls. Meanwhile, Emma is having family dramas of her own. With Zane’s unwitting help, Denman’s research at Mako Island uncovers the girls' secret!
Marshall is love's reluctant mail carrier when the ghost of a 1920s smitten teen demands that Marshall delivers a love letter to the spirit's dreamgirl, now an elderly woman.
Marshall needs to be saved from daylight savings (which isn't in effect in Eerie) after he resets his time and falls into a dimension always one hour behind.
An artistic girl's sketches take on a life of their own. Realizing her capability, she attempts to draw the perfect family.
Marshall and Simon think they've finally found someone who will believe them - a traveling professor of the 'parabelievable.' But should they be believing him?
Naomi is extremely self-conscious about her height.  That, plus the fact that shes the only girl on her class field trip to the Egyptian Pyramids.

Petey and the rest of the guys are looking forward to a week of summer R and R at Camp Rockbotom until flat-topped Counsellor Bill call them to attention and informs them that there will be no time for fun.
Frasier has trouble deciding between two women and ends up losing them both. Niles mistakenly goes to a local beach in the buff.
Troubled by his recent relationship woes, Frasier goes to the country for peace and quiet, but ends up facing the ghosts of failed relationships past.
Daphne is tortured by pangs of jealousy when she learns one of Niles's patients is in love with him. Frasier and Martin go to extreme lengths to catch a cricket hiding in the apartment.
Martin goes back to work as a security guard and reflects on his last day as a cop, when he was shot.

Roz comes face-to-face with her own snobbery when she dates a garbage man. Frasier's plan to convince his co-workers that he isn't an elitist snob backfires when he becomes more popular than he wants.

Frasier's psychological party game brings unpleasant revelations at his Halloween party. Niles dresses as Martin and gets drunk on beer. The children in the apartment building believe that Frasier eats kids' brains.
On their 8th anniversary of living together, Frasier accidentally destroys Martin's recliner. Niles discovers Daphne has no talent for music.
Frasier becomes obsessed with replacing a missing tape in his collection of all 2,000 of his shows.
Blood pressures and spirits rise as an intern becomes the pawn in Frasier and Niles' battle over a wine cellar tour.
Frasier's show has been losing the ratings to a hot new program, Dr. Zach, which has a heavy advertising budget. KACL refuses to match their exposure, so Frasier calls on Bebe to turn the screws.
Martin gets criticized at work and decides to let it go; however, Frasier and Niles can't. They decide to interfere, which leads to a lengthy confinement in a storage room.
The arrival of Daphne's mother derails her plans to move in with Niles. Frasier gets into a war with his upstairs neighbor over a parking spot.
The arrival of Daphne's mother derails her plans to move in with Niles. Frasier gets into a war with his upstairs neighbor over a parking spot.

Frasier agrees to go on a teen show to boost his ratings among younger listeners, but is bushwhacked by the show's sensationalism-seeking hosts. Niles gets arrested making a romantic gesture for Daphne.
Niles gets everyone involved in his elaborate plans to propose to Daphne. An ill-timed lie ruins Martin's chances with Peg.
Frasier struggles not to be taken in by Lilith's conniving brother.
Niles, Roz and Martin play matchmaker for Frasier who hasn't been on a date in a few months now.
Frasier is more nervous than his son when Frederick competes in the National Spelling Championship, and the elder Crane ends up ruining everything for his offspring.
Revisiting the home of their childhood, Frasier and Niles find a human skull and become obsessed with proving that their former landlord murdered his wife.
When Frasier and his neighbor Cam begin feuding, Martin and Cam's mother hatch a plot to patch up the relationship.
Frasier returns to Boston to give a speech, and Niles, Daphne, and Martin tag along to see the city. Once there, Frasier runs into Cliff Clavin.
Frasier finds a cold welcome in his new market of Spokane when he replaces a beloved local radio personality.
Frasier and Roz worry about ruining their friendship after they sleep together. Niles goes to England looking for Daphne's missing father.
Niles brings Daphne's father to Seattle in hopes of convincing him to reunite with her mother.
Niles and Daphne fake two wedding ceremonies after eloping to Reno.
A very bad-tempered Frasier takes out his frustration through an act of civil disobedience, refusing to pay a small parking fee and blocking the exit lane of the garage.
Martin runs for condo board president and Frasier does all the work.
Roz feels old when her twenty-something cousin comes to town.
Frasier plots revenge when Bulldog plays a Halloween prank on him.
Frasier delivers a speech in Klingon at his son's Bar Mitzvah.
Niles fears that his toothache is the symptom of a heart condition.
Niles' surgery brings about reflection of the past, present and future.
Niles has to step up to the plate after having a heart-rending scare.

Michael Keaton plays a husband and father who loses his job as an engineer at the auto manufacturing plant. After struggling to find another job, his wife lands a high paying position at an advertising agency.
Two bullied high school students place an ad for a bodyguard in a magazine and receive a response from a homeless verteran.

Our non-heinous heroes Bill (Alex Winter) and Ted (Keanu Reeves) are in danger of flunking history! But when the righteous Rufus (George Carlin) arrives in a time-travelling phone booth, the dense dudes discover their destiny!
Sledge must discover who is making threatening calls to a radio psychologist.
Sledge poses as an assassin to discover a mobster's secret hideout.
Thad brags that he doesn't need to get laid because of his Pocket Pussy. One of the players steals Thad's PP and the team all take turns using it, not knowing that it is carrying syphilis.
Billy the goat mascot and Sammy are kidnapped by a rival school.
A New York Department of Integration social worker helps supernatural creatures adapt to city life.
Callie goes baby-crazy when Mark fosters a demon orphan, and Twayne notices odd changes in his body.
While Frank and his dad tend to an emergency at the airport, Sue spends a maddening night at the hospital, and Bill takes a beating in the hockey rink.
Frank's pledge to be a better father and husband by one calamity after the next, leading to an epic meltdown at Lamaze class.

This week Greg Davis and assistant Alex Horne engage in some role-play to assess the success of a throwing task. Plus Noel Fielding has a sliding session, Swedishman Fred receives an intense video call and all hell breaks loose in The Battle of the Bath.

Five comedians continue to vie for the highly coveted golden sculpture of Taskmaster Greg Davies's bonce. This week: camel carnage, carrier bag football and the dark secrets of the Taskmaster's sleeping bag.
Jen has found love and is hosting a dinner party with her new bloke Peter and six of their single friends.
When a bad bra causes Jen to lose concentration in a board meeting, Moss invents a bra that will never, ever go bad.
When the Mayor's kid blows his thumb off with an illegal explosive, the officers are put on the line to rid Reno of contraband fireworks.
The deputies partake in a scavenger hunt to determine who gets to attend the execution of a convicted felon, and Williams gives a suspect a makeover.
Jones enjoys some unexpected perks after being relegated to crossing guard duty, and Dangle's bike is stolen again.
A mandatory staff drug test reveals a surprise pregnancy, and Lt. Dangle has a brush with a celebrity.
Lindsay's well-intentioned interference breaks up Nick's band; Sam confronts his deepest fear - showering after gym class.
Sam and his fellow Geeks fall head over heels for a pretty transfer student; Lindsay attempts to get fake identification cards for herself and the Freaks.
