Melinda is contacted by Grace, a popular former classmate, because she thinks she is being haunted.
A ghost haunts an online gaming community and Melinda joins the game to find a way to help the ghost.
On a cruise ship filled with ghosts, Melinda tries to help a ghost looking for the fiancé who wronged her.
A woman who was accidentally switched at birth dies in surgery.
Melinda tries to calm ghosts causing issues at a wedding.
While dealing with issues in her personal life, Melinda has difficulty helping a troubled teenage ghost.
After Jim's spirit goes into another body, Melinda tries to help him regain his memory.
Melinda helps the ghost of a little girl who has been missing for 12 years and blames her brother.
A confused ghost must get needs Melinda's help to come to terms with her marriage and cross over.
Melinda helps a 14 year boy bring his parents back together so they will discuss the real reason for his death.
On a road trip with Jim/Sam, Melinda encounters her fair share of trouble.
Melinda discovers a local lake is filled with distressed ghosts because their bodies have been dumped there rather than properly cremated.
Melinda helps a ghost protect her daughter from dating a bad boy.
Melinda encounters the spirit who died during a sorority initiation ceremony while searching for a girl that's gone missing in the same manner.
Linus investigates a haunting with high tech equipment while Melinda tells Jim/Sam about her gift.
Melinda and Jim/Sam work to understand what's happening in a troubled kindergarten class.
Melinda encounters another "step in" spirit like Jim/Sam.

Samantha and Jay throw both caution and money to the wind when they decide to convert a rundown country estate they inherited into a bed and breakfast - only to find it's inhabited by the many spirits of deceased residents who now call it home.

Samantha and Jay throw both caution and money to the wind when they decide to convert a rundown country estate they inherited into a bed & breakfast - only to find it's inhabited by the many opinionated spirits of deceased residents who now call it home.
When Thorfinn's bones are discovered on the Woodstone property, he asks Sam to conduct the traditional Viking funeral he's always wanted.
When Sam and Jay invite their nosy neighbors to a dinner party to woo them into allowing the bed and breakfast, the ghosts are desperately eager to be included on the guest list.
On Halloween at Woodstone Mansion, the ghosts try to help Sam and Jay protect their home from the neighborhood kids who vandalize it every year.
Pete convinces Sam to invite his living wife to the mansion, only to discover she's been keeping a dark secret from him for many years.

When Sam is commissioned to write an article about Flower and her friends holding up a bank during their commune days, Flower begs Sam not to accept the job because she's embarrassed about a part of the story she's never revealed.
After Jay is kicked out of a Dungeons & Dragons campaign with his city friends, Sam agrees to facilitate a new one between him and the ghosts.
Alberta is thrilled when a super-fan of her music visits the mansion to learn more about her. Also, Thor convinces Hetty to go for a walk with him, hoping it will spark a special memory.
Hetty accidentally possesses Jay's body just as he and Sam are about to show Woodstone Mansion to a renowned wedding planner.
Sam and Jay travel to where Sam's mother, Sheryl (Rachael Harris), died to see if she's now a ghost. Also, Sasappis divulges a secret he overheard Sam and Jay discussing to his fellow ghosts.
When Jay's sister, Bela (Punam Patel), comes to visit Sam and Jay after being dumped by her boyfriend, they're shocked to discover that she's communicating with someone they know on a dating app.
Just as Sam and Jay are set to host a friend's wedding that could get their B&B business off the ground, the ghost of Hetty's husband, Elias Woodstone (Matt Walsh), tries to ruin it.

When Sasappis offers to help Sam complete the B&B website so they can start taking reservations, they butt heads over creative direction. Also, Pete bonds with Jay over basketball until Jay makes a friend, and Flower tries to be Pete's basketball buddy.
When Sam and Jay have the ghosts bunk together to free up rooms for guests at the B&B, they learn that Thorfinn has been having night terrors, which inspires Sam to enlist a therapist to help him.

The secret about Trevor's missing pants is finally revealed when his wealthy former friend comes to Woodstone Mansion to buy the timepiece Sam and Jay found on Elias Woodstone's corpse. Also, Thor decides to tell Flower how he feels about her.

An '80s "mean girl" ghost named Stephanie (Odessa A'Zion), who died on her prom night, is awakened in the attic, triggering Sam to confront what happened on her own prom night. Also, Alberta discovers she has another special gift.

As Sam and Jay await the arrival of their first official bed-and-breakfast guests, they face obstacles triggered by a Norse curse placed upon them by Thorfinn, and Isaac takes a huge, centuries-in-the-making step in his personal life.
Sam enlists the Ghosts to help secure a good review from an overly critical couple staying at the B&B. Also, Isaac tries to bring Nigel into his friend group in the second-season premiere.
Sam decides to host a podcast exploring the mystery surrounding Alberta's death. Also, Hetty develops an unusual relationship with a broken washing machine.

Sam becomes alarmed when the ghosts suggest Jay's new friends may be part of a cult run by a charismatic leader named Micah (Drew Tarver). Also, Pete changes his attitude after Sasappis criticizes his unceasing cheeriness.

Sasappis convinces Sam and Jay to try saving an old tree on the Woodstone property that the neighbors want to cut down. Also, Thor attempts to become more environmentally friendly to get Flower's attention.

programmes.st: Halloween 2: The Ghost of Hetty's Past
programmes.d: A séance at Sam and Jay's last-minute Halloween party conjures up a spirit from Hetty's past. Also, Isaac worries Nigel will be turned off by his ghost power.
Sam meets a Viking ghost at the Farnsbys' house who has an unexpected connection to Thorfinn. Also, Trevor devises a new method for the ghosts to trade favors.
When a television documentary crew comes to Woodstone Mansion to shoot an episode of "Dumb Deaths," Pete confronts a hard truth about the day he died.

Alberta's past expertise comes in handy when Sam and Jay run into complications during their Woodstone whiskey-tasting soiree. Also, Trevor devises a ghost fraternity, which inspires a revelation from Isaac's past.
Jay's sister, Bela (Punam Patel), visits Woodstone Mansion and brings along an adoring male friend, inspiring Sam to spark a romance between them in the spirit of the holiday rom-coms she loves.

Sam and Thorfinn get caught in the crossfire as the scheme Jay's sister, Bela (Punam Patel), and the ghosts have conjured up goes awry. Isaac's marriage to Beatrice sheds light on how apprehensive he has been in communicating his feelings to Nigel.

Sam and Jay are thrilled when they find a highly qualified assistant for the B&B; however, their new employee comes with some surprising baggage. Also, Thorfinn tries to help his son, Bjorn, deal with a bully.

Sam gives relationship advice to her and Jay's assistant, Freddie (Mike Lane), ignoring Hetty's warning not to get too close to "the help." Also, Sasappis strikes up a romance with Jessica (Nichole Sakura), the ghost who lives in Freddie's car.

Sam and Jay's assistant, Freddie (Mike Lane), purchases ghost-hunting equipment when suspicious activity leads him to theorize the B&B is haunted. Also, Sasappis risks losing his relationship with Jessica (Nichole Sakura) when Freddie sells his car.
Trevor receives disturbing news about his parents when they come to Woodstone B&B to collect his newly discovered remains. Also, Isaac and Nigel's relationship hits a roadblock.
ETERNALLY YOURS is a family comedy about a vampire couple's pulseless marriage after 500 years.

No one will sell Spydra land to build her new, improved Spydravania.
Spydra substitutes all the toys with special remote controlled evil toys so she can infiltrate people’s homes and control the world children!
Spydra wants her production of Shakespeare's King John to be perfect.
Dr. Claw schemes with two magicians, the Lesser and the Great Wambini, to steal gold bars from the bank vault.

Pets owned by the city's rich and famous are disappearing, and Inspector Gadget's job is to investigate and locate the missing pets. The MAD magician, the Great Wambini, invites the missing pet owners to a siance.
Chief Quimby warns Inspector Gadget of a MAD plot to steal the famous King of Alpacastan's llama that spits diamonds.
Chief Quimby reveals a MAD plot to steal Metro City's gold to Inspector Gadget. Inspector Gadget is instructed to proceed to the mint and stop the robbery, while Penny and Brain follow.

As Inspector Gadget is washing the Gadget mobile, he promises to teach Capeman the rules of crime fighting. Chief Quimby arrives to inform Inspector Gadget of MAD's eighth anniversary, which will be celebrated with eight bold crimes.
Dr. Claw plots with Dr. Noodleman to dismantle Gadget of his gadgets with the aid of various vintage hospital surgical tools.

Dr. Claw plots with Dr. Shieskopf to eliminate Gadget with his latest invention, the Linguinis, which are five little men with teeth sharp enough to chew up any material object.  Quimby warns Gadget of a suspected MAD plot to make attempts on his life.

Dr. Claw hires Dr. Shieskopf to invent a shrinking ray gun to shrink Inspector Gadget down to the size of a mouse. Quimby orders Gadget to investigate a suspected MAD plot at the Eccentric Invention Convention.
Gadget is planning a trip on the Oriental Express Mystery Tour Train and is warned by Quimby about a MAD plot to kill him while aboard.

programmes.st: Bad Dreams Are Made of This
programmes.d: Dr. Claw, with the assistance of Dr. Spectrum and Bert Sweetley, uses a dream beam to give the citizens of Metro City nightmares.  He plans to make everyone too tired to work, so they will buy his Dreamway machine.
Quimby informs Gadget that ghosts are in the homes of Metro City's most distinguished families and a MAD plot is suspected.
Claw realizing Gadget isn't dead sends ghosts to kill him. Gadget tries to arrest the ghosts. Agents #1 and #2 are dressed as Ghost Catchers, shooting rancid grease all over the mansion.

Watch Inspector Gadget every weeknight at 7/6c on Pluto TV.  Dr. Claw, with the help of identical twin MAD scientists Null and Void, steals a space station to extort millions of dollars from the earth's citizens.
To celebrate his birthday, Dr. Claw has Null and Void invent Kewpie doll bombs to explode on the moon and create the MAD logo.
With a black box controlled by his console, Dr. Claw schemes with the twin scientists, Null and Void, to intercept Metro City's bank transactions by manipulating their satellite transmissions.
A time machine helps Dr. Claw go back in time to destroy Gadgets' ancestors to eliminate him and bring back dinosaurs to rule Metro City.

When Quimby learns Thelma is being sent back to ancient Rome to learn the Secret of Roma inscribed on a mosaic at the Forum, he sends Gadget to stop her in the time machine. Gadget is also anxious to meet his ancient Roman relative, Gadgetorum.
Dr. Claw has located GADGET'S 19th Century relatives, living in London. He sends Thelma back in time to dispose of them, thus doing away with GADGET at the same time.
Dr. Claw, frustrated by the poor quality of Mad agents, goes to ask for help from an old Sicilian don named the Great Godfather.
Gadget has ordered a new watch. He gets his orders from Chief Quimby that Mad is unleashing weapons disguised as novelties.
Inspector Gadget and Capeman are attempting to test out their latest invention, the Gadzooka, a bazooka that shoots acid sour cream.
Inspector Gadget saves Professor Frafkin, the world's leading scientist, from being kidnapped by Dr. Claw.
Inspector Gadget and Penny head off on a vacation in the country when they get a frantic call from the Chief that Dr. Claw has stolen an experimental missile.
The M.A.D. agents trying to destroy the circus are no match for Inspector Gadget, Penny and Chief Quimby.
Inspector Gadget prevents Dr. Claw from kidnapping the father of modern bionics, Professor Von Slicksfein.
Inspector Gadget foils Dr. Claw's plans to destroy him while on a vacation at a health spa.
Inspector Gadget's undercover assignment takes place on a luxury liner where the wealthiest people in the world are on holiday.  His mission is to prevent Dr. Claw from stealing their jewels.
Dr. Claw tries to sabotage a crime fighter's convention held at Count Dracula's home in Transylvania.

programmes.st: Don't Share Your Man With Others!; Teen's Two Wrecks in Two Days!
programmes.d: A woman dates a man she knows is seeing other people, and it doesn't end well when his personal belongings go missing; a responsible teen motorist confesses that he was at fault and offers to get a job to pay for damages to a fellow teen driver.

programmes.st: Party Bus Catastrophe!; Desolate Salon or Desperate Recruiter?!
programmes.d: A woman celebrating her 46th birthday gets left in the lurch when her private bus never shows up; a salon owner hires a recruiter to increase revenue but ends up suing her for breach of contract.
Secondhand smoke, accusations of verbal abuse and an attempt at marriage counseling come into play when unwed parents play house.

programmes.st: Never Hire Family!; Police Come to Woman's Aid
programmes.d: A family member goes after a relative for unpaid services; a woman resorts to police help to recover a truck her former friend rented.

Lucy's mother wants to join the Ricardos on their road trip out west. As anticipated, Ricky blows his stack when he hears that Lucy's mother wants to go along, and continues to complain that everyone's going on the trip.

The Ricardos and the Mertzes have a hard time finding accommodations that will please everyone on their trip to California. Ricky is driving and sacrifices his passengers' appetites for the sake of making mileage.
The Ricardos and the Mertzes are arrested when they're caught speeding in Bent Fork, Tennessee. Although Ricky just wants to pay the fine, Lucy protests that they are being treated unfairly.

The Ricardos and the Mertzes, on the last leg of their NY-to-Hollywood motor trek, stop at Ethel's hometown of Albuquerque, New Mexico. Under the impression that Ethel has been called to Hollywood by the movies, the townsfolk give her the star treatment.

After five weeks on the road driving across the country, the Ricardos and the Mertzes arrive at their destination – Hollywood. With stars in her eyes, Lucy heads for the Brown Derby, a restaurant frequented by celebrities, with Ethel and Fred in tow.

Lucy is jealous when Ricky is asked to pose with five beautiful starlets for publicity photos and tries to get herself in on the action by inserting herself into every shot. Lucy is even more upset when Ricky goes to his first Hollywood premiere.

Lucy is desperate to appear in a Hollywood movie after hearing the Mertzes have bit parts in an upcoming feature. She sets out to be "discovered" and lands a part in an MGM musical. She plays a showgirl in a glamorous nightclub scene but has some trouble.

Lucy convinces Ricky to allow her to buy a Don Loper dress so she'll fit in with the Hollywood scene. Lucy and Ethel hit the couturier's salon but soon realize the dresses are way out of their price range.

Lucy arrives in Hollywood with Little Ricky to meet her husband and his new press agent, who intends on making Ricky the "Cuban Liberace." Charlie Pomerantz plans a publicity stunt he hopes will get Ricky into Hedda Hopper's gossip column.

Lucy learns her husband's film Don Juan will be shelved and works frantically with the Mertzes and Mrs. McGillicuddy to prevent it from happening. Together they write hundreds of fan letters and dress up as members of the Ricky Ricardo Fan Club.

Lucy has agreed to write an article entitled "What It's Like To Be Married To Ricky Ricardo" for a magazine when she learns from Ricky's press agent that Ricky is going to host a TV show. Lucy desperately wants to appear on the show with Ricky.

Ricky forgot the date of his 15th anniversary and desperately wires the records department in Greenwich, Connecticut where they were married to find out. In his defense, Ricky tells Lucy that he's already planned a big "surprise" anniversary party.
Lucy learns a movie star, Cornel Wilde, is staying in the penthouse directly above the Ricardos' apartment and sets out to catch a glimpse of the handsome actor.

Lucy and Ricky, and Fred and Ethel are fed up with each other's annoying habits and decide they all need a break. They split up for a brief vacation and Lucy and Ethel decide they'll go to Palm Springs for a girls-only good time.

Lucy's friend Caroline Abbleby decides she'll pay Lucy a visit while on her way to Hawaii, and can't wait for Lucy to introduce her to all the stars she has supposedly befriended. Lucy's only solution is to trick her friend and set the stage for deceit.
Caroline Appleby is visiting from New York and is excited to see all the stars Lucy had promised. Of course Lucy exaggerated her access to celebrities but plans on fooling her nearsighted friend.

Lucy decides that Ricky needs an agent to negotiate more money and cut down on his fruitless personal appearances, so she appoints herself. Her fast talking, no-nonsense actions result in the studio canceling Ricky's contract.
Although Ricky is having lunch with Richard Widmark, he refuses to introduce Lucy because she has become a legend around Hollywood for her crazy escapades.
The Ricardos are going back to New York in one week and Lucy is determined not to leave Hollywood with the proper souvenirs. She's already got a box full of memorabilia but she still wants more.
Lucy, while souvenir collecting, lifted a cement block with John Wayne's footprints from Grauman's Chinese Theatre, and now a newspaper is reporting that she was seen and her arrest is imminent.
Chip Jackson of MGM asks Ricky to perform at a party but he refuses in favor of a deep-sea fishing retreat. Lucy has a better idea - she tells Mr. Jackson that Ricky would be glad to appear.
When Ricky makes a little money by selling his car, he forgets to tell his New York neighbors who drove out with him to Hollywood that he will buy their return train tickets.

Lucy, unaccustomed to train travel, is sure her trip to New York will be filled with intrigue and romance. When she hears that a jewel thief is on board, she sees herself as the possible heroine of the situation despite Ricky's admonitions to leave.

On their return from Hollywood, Lucy has her hands full with Ricky when he is hailed as a major celebrity. The Ricardos' neighbors join for a grand homecoming celebration and block party in Ricky's honor when the Ricardos and Mertze return together.

Ricky Ricardo's new fame leads to an invitation to appear on a television interview program. The live interview is to take place in their home and Ricky's new agent wants them to move to a more posh apartment.

Ricky cannot help Fred out by performing at his lodge show because he is already booked for a radio show that day. Lucy volunteers to help out so she and Fred whip up a Western act. Ricky discovers it's a rodeo show that he's booked for, not a radio show.

Ricky finds Lucy exhausted after a trying day with little Ricky and insists it is time their son started nursery school. Lucy's protests are overridden and Ricky takes young Ricky to nursery school, but the baby comes down with tonsillitis.

Ricky is offered a European booking that is too important to refuse but he can't afford to take Lucy with him. Lucy is furious at the prospect of being left behind, and when Ricky wants to take Fred Mertz along as the tour manager, Ethel too, is incensed.

Lucy is unable to produce her birth certificate to get a passport for the Ricardos' and Mertzes' European jaunt. She calls her hometown for the birth certificate but discovers that none exists for her.
Fred's fear of becoming seasick threatens the Mertzes' and Ricardos' plans for Ricky's European band tour. They are all booked on the ocean liner Constitution for the trans-Atlantic voyage.

The Ricardos and Mertzes are on the deck of the Constitution, ready to set sail for Europe when Lucy rushes down the gangplank for one last goodbye to Little Ricky who will be in her mother's care while she is away.

Lucy anticipates a 2nd honeymoon with Ricky on their boat trip to Europe, but Ricky's band duties keep him too busy. Lucy happily looks forward to romantic evenings and daytime deck games on board the ship as the Ricardos and the Mertzes sail for Europe.
Lucy is thrilled at being in London, and most of all wants to see the Queen. She misses the Queen at Buckingham Palace where she and Ethel try to make the guard smile.
The artists team up to put their texture skills to the test in an animal-themed Elimination Tattoo, and an unexpected twist results in a shocking elimination.
Canvases sit for personalized postcard tattoos, and the artists feel the pressure when they're tasked with designing Trash Polka Elimination Tattoos.

programmes.st: Like a Moth to the Flame
programmes.d: The Flash Challenge gets explosive when the artists paint with fire, the artists design Neptune tattoos, and veteran tattoo artist Justin Weatherholtz joins as a guest judge.
The artists must paint custom designs for muscle cars, a morphing anatomical heart tattoo keeps the artists on their toes, and tattoo artist Rose Hardy is a guest judge.
Virgin canvases sit for fingernail tattoos, the artists replicate fine art masterpieces in the Elimination Tattoo, and museum curator Carter Foster is a guest judge.
The contestants join forces with inspiring guest artists in the Flash Challenge, and a throat placement Elimination Tattoo throws the artists off of their games.
The artists test their technical application with realistic football designs in the Flash Challenge, and professional football players call the shots in the Elimination Tattoo.
The artists are tasked with designing art using nails, and military personnel brings their loved ones as they sit for portraits in a high-pressure Elimination Tattoo.
The remaining four artists must survive a tattoo marathon, and the contestants are given the chance to redo their previously botched tattoos to secure a spot in the finale.
Eliminated artists return to confront one another, and for the first time ever, the final three artists tattoo live for $100,000 and the title of Ink Master.
The battle for $100,000 and the title of Ink Master begins as new artists are thrown into the fire in an intense Flash Challenge, and the first veteran artist returns.
Egos collide when the artists are forced to get their hands dirty in a team Flash Challenge, and another veteran artist returns to clean up the competition.
Creativity is tested in a salty Flash Challenge, the artists transform their canvases into comic-book characters, and another veteran artist returns.
Forensics expert Adrian Gardner assesses the artists' fingerprint tattoos in the Flash Challenge, and a veteran artist's return sparks old rivalries.
The artists team up to transform contortionists using body paint, and a veteran artist returns to add a new-school twist to an old subject.
New alliances are formed during a high-pressure Flash Challenge, and a veteran artist joins forces with the new artists in an effort to take down a common enemy.
Alliances are broken during a white-knuckled Flash Challenge, a veteran artist returns, and the artists must design political portraits in the Elimination Tattoo.
Muso attacks Kagome. Inuyasha destroys him with his Wind Scar. Naraku, who was watching the event, tells Kagura to tell Inuyasha where Muso went.
Muso regenerates even thought he was hit with the Wind Scar. Miroku tells Inuyasha that Muso has a heart in the area where he has a spider marking.
Inuyasha visits Totosai in search of a technique that can break through Naraku's barrier. There he meets Bunza, a wildcat-demon child.
Myoga comes to deliver a message from Totosai.

programmes.st: The Red Tetsusaiga Breaks the Barrier!
programmes.d: The Hyakki Bat demon Otakemaru tries to destroy the village along with Shiori's mother.

programmes.st: The Plot of the Panther Devas
programmes.d: The Panther Tribe attacks from the west.
Inuyasha slices through the Panthers' barrier with his red Tetsusaiga, and Inuyasha and Koga make their way into the castle town.

programmes.st: The Panther Tribe and the Two Swords of the Fang
programmes.d: The Panther King, the general of the Panther Tribe, begins to move with the power of the Shikon Jewel. Inuyasha and Sesshomaru attack the mummy.
Sango is asked to slay a demon by a young lord named Kuranosuke, who fell in love with her six years ago. Kuranosuke has looks, status, and wealth.
The Tetsusaiga is equipped with a technique that can break through barriers. Jaken plans to steal it from Inuyasha, but his plans continually fail.
Naraku tells Sesshomaru that he'll give Rin back if he kills Inuyasha, but Sesshomaru charges into Naraku's castle instead.
Naraku is trying to absorb Sesshomaru so that he can get the powers of a complete demon. But Inuyasha breaks through his barrier and interferes.
Kagome returns to the present day. She is busy preparing for a mock exam two days later.

programmes.st: The Female Wolf-Demon and the Lunar Rainbow Promise
programmes.d: Ayame, a female demon wolf, appears before Koga and tells him that she is his fiancée. But Koga is madly in love with Kagome.
Ayame brought Koga to stop her comrades' fighting. But she has no intention of returning to Koga.

programmes.st: The Evil Within Demon's Head Castle
programmes.d: Inuyasha and the gang meet an old lady who's a seemingly fake purifier.
Inuyasha fights the lord of Ogre Castle. Sanfo hears that Miroku has gone to the basement with the princess, and goes after him with the old purifier.
Kikyo looks for Naraku. She meets Kansuke, an old bandit. Kansuke has a serious illness and is trying to find a place to die.

programmes.st: The Three Sprites of the Monkey God
programmes.d: Inuyasha and the gang accept a job to get rid of monkeys who are destroying fields. They meet three monkeys, Gon, Bun, and Ken.

programmes.st: Nursing Battle of the Rival Lovers
programmes.d: Kagome catches a cold and returns to the present day. Inuyasha is worried about her. He gathers lots of nutritious food.
Kagome's younger brother, Sota, has fallen in love. He has fallen in love with Hitomi, one of his classmates.

programmes.st: The Suspicious Faith Healer and the Black Kirara
programmes.d: Tesso, a mouse demon who is afraid of cats, transforms into a faith healer, and chases out Kuroro, a Nekomata who is bothering him.
Kikyo was brought back to life by one of Urasue's secret techniques. She meets Monju, who is in the same situation.
In a certain village, Inuyasha and the gang are surrounded by villagers who dislike Miroku.
Inuyasha and the gang meet Izumo, who is investigating the secret of the creation of the Sacred Jewel.
Kagome and the others are kidnapped by demons who are using fake Sacred Jewels. Inuyasha and the rest go to save them, but Gyuoh stands in their way.
Naraku's poisonous bugs appear. Sesshomaru goes after them. Meanwhile, Jaken is stung by a poisonous bug and is dying. Rin is left with him.
Kirara disappears. Sango is worried. Shippo deduces Kirara's reasons for disappearing.

programmes.st: Kikyo and Kagome: Alone in the Cave
programmes.d: Kagome is lured to a cave by a voice calling for help. Kagome enters the cave and meets Kikyo.

programmes.st: Koga and Sesshomaru: A Dangerous Encounter
programmes.d: Ginta and Hakkaku fight with Koga over something small, and end up working separately from him. As they do, they meet Sesshomaru's group.

programmes.st: The Truth Behind the Nightmare: Battle in the Forest of Sorrow
programmes.d: Garamaru, a poisonous moth demon, has trapped Kagome and the others in a cocoon. Kagome and the others are each suffering within their nightmares.

programmes.st: The Snow from Seven Years Past
programmes.d: Snow is falling out of season. Miroku is abducted by Koyuki, a mysterious woman.
A giant ogre appears in the mountains to the north. His name is Kyokotsu. Kyokotsu eats demons when he can. He attacks the demon wolf tribe.
Jane and Rafael realize that the uncertain state of their relationship is stressing out Mateo and they decide they need to make a decision.
Jane and Rafael try to be friends which works great until Jane goes on a date.  Petra and Jane's new partnership is off to a rocky start, but they know they have to find a way through it.
Jane is ready to move on from the Marbella and pursue writing full time, but an unexpected development forces her to consider returning to her teaching roots.
Jane's fixation on a negative review has left her with writer's block, so Rogelio suggests she take a class to help.
When Jane, Rogelio and Alba learn what is going on with Xo, they all try to comfort her, but Xo insists they let her live her life.
Xo struggles to make an important decision and looks to Jane for guidance leaving Rogelio feeling like an outsider.
After Jane, Rafael, Petra and JR all go out together, Jane is upset to learn that JR doesn't like her. Jane and Rafael brush off a big relationship moment, but they try to make up for it.
Jane and Rafael find themselves in a not ideal living situation in order to save money.  When Rafael sees Alba try to punish Mateo, an unexpected rift is formed.
Jane believes she and Rafael are in a good place until she realizes he is keeping a secret from her.  Alba's big day has finally arrived, and Jane, Xo and Rogelio are ready to celebrate.

Jane makes a shocking discovery and looks to Rafael for answers, but is confused by his decision to put everything they have on hold. Meanwhile, Petra is trying to secure a future with JR, but her past might jeopardize everything.

With Jane's Catholic guilt starting to settle in, she turns to Alba for advice and gets an unexpected answer. Luisa decides to go see Rose with Rafael by her side, in order to help get answers. Meanwhile, Rogelio is back to work with River.

Jane must get over the newest hurdle in her life, which proves to be harder than she hoped. Rogelio discovers that he and River are not as equal as he thought. Meanwhile, Jane and Petra must deal with the children not getting along.
After talking to everyone else about what is going on in her life, Jane turns to Petra, who she knows will give her a straight answer. In return, Petra leans on Jane for advice about JR.

Jane reluctantly agrees to let Rogelio throw her a big 30th birthday party. Jane's mentor gives her some important advice that may help her start writing again. Meanwhile, Petra thinks she and JR are finally in a good place.

Jane struggles with giving Rafael his space after she discovers that he is hiding a secret. Jane and Michael uncover clues about what happened the day he "died." Petra wants to fit into JR's world and enlists Jane's help.

Jane is trying to go with the flow, so when Michael makes a suggestion that takes her out of her comfort zone, Jane decides to go for it. Jane struggles with her feelings for Raphael while Michael slides back into his old life.

Jane is having a hard time dealing with Rafael avoiding her, so when an issue with Mateo comes up she uses it to get some face time. Rogelio turns to Jane for help when he learns his pilot is in trouble.
Jennifer is accusing Michelle of causing the car crash and is suing her for the damages to her car.
Jill is suing Laura after failing to repay a loan, but Laura says it was a gift.
Andrea wants $3000 from her ex-boyfriend after stealing from her during her active addiction.
Ashley is suing her former friend, Terra, for not returning her dog after caring for it while she was in rehab.

programmes.st: Putting a Roof Over 5 Kids’ Heads
programmes.d: Sarah sues her ex-husband for rent, saying their marriage fell apart due to trust issues and infidelity.
After Vera's son was murdered in 2014, she learned that Alstin may be her grandson, and wants a DNA test.
Prestonie sues his mother for assault and hotel bills and claims she admitted to hating him.
Juana is suing Jorge after the bird he sold her died after 3 hours, she wants her money back for the bird and autopsy.
Jamal says he's suing jealous ex-girlfriend for trying to run him over after accusing him of cheating on her.
Two sisters feud over the family heritance ends up in Judge Marilyn Milian's court room
Darral has been brought to court after towing Chester's car who he believes was carelessly double parked illegally.

programmes.st: You Sold Me A Sick Puppy!
programmes.d: After Billie's puppy died 6 days after purchase, she demands the seller reimburse her for vet bills, pain and suffering.
Arsenio is taking his ex-tenant to court after claiming she left the unit a mess including leaving two buckets of urine.
Tyra is accusing her friend since highschool of allowing her car to be towed and junked due to a parking ticket dispute.
Destiny is suing her Father for property damage after she claims he damaged the hood of her car.
Tania is suing her child's father for not reimbursing her for a cruise his daughter from another woman came on.
Donna says the defendants stored their old beat up RV on her property and they owe her money.

When Lucas finds out he isn't really a human, but actually a monster, the news changes his whole world! Embarking on a quest to Monster Island to discover his real roots, Lucas will undergo a journey he will never forget.

After Emma Wishbone drags her family to a costume party on Halloween night, they are all cursed by an evil witch and transformed into monsters. Now Emma must fight to keep her Monster Family together and uncover the secret of their curse…
A 3D-animated movie set in Paris in the year 1910 and centered on a monster who lives in a garden and his love for a beautiful, young singer.
The magical inhabitants of a rainforest fight to save their home, which is threatened by logging and a polluting force of destruction called Hexxus.
In the dark of night aliens fly their war ships to earth and abduct all the parents in Jimmy's hometown of Retroville. So it's up to Jimmy to rescue the abducted parents.
It's an adventure of a lifetime when a baby tiger cub escapes from an animal sanctuary and follows a young boy home.

programmes.t: A Turtle's Tale 2: Sammy's Escape From Paradise
programmes.d: When Sammy and Ray find themselves trapped in The Tank, an underwater aquarium, they must hatch a plan to escape and reunite with their grandkids, Ricky and Ella, and protect them from the dangers of the ocean.
Join Polly and her friends as they board a magical plane to reunite a lost cat named Torta with her owner Eva, a Brazilian dancer from Rio de Janeiro.

In a world filled with Mad Scientists and Evil Inventions, one talented evil scientist's hunch-backed lab assistant has big dreams of becoming a Mad Scientist himself and winning the annual Evil Science Fair.

In love with Marina, the most beautiful penguin in all the land, hopeless romantic Hubie must thwart the plans of his evil rival, Drake, and win Marina's heart in this charming animated adventure from the creators of All Dogs Go to Heaven.
Tara Adams is just an ordinary high school junior, except for one little thing. Tara has a secret identity-she's Radio Rebel, the most popular radio DJ in Seattle.

programmes.st: Would You Like to Enter Prime Empire?
programmes.d: While investigating a heist, the ninja discover Prime Empire, an unreleased arcade game that suddenly takes control of all other games in Ninjago
When the ninja connect Jay's disappearance to Prime Empire, they set out to Dyer Island to seek answers from the game's designer, Milton Dyer.
Cyrus Borg discovers a secret about Prime Empire while the ninja battle an escaped Mechanic in an attempt to reach Level Thirteen and enter the game.
Inside Prime Empire, the ninja are in unfamiliar territory, ignorant of the rules, as they try to find Zane and escape Unagami's Red Visors.
Inside one of the game zones, a Samurai named Okino faces a crisis of faith when he  fails to lead a series of Masters to victory.
The search for the Sandman leads Mateo and the others to the tallest mountain in the Dream World,but Lunia's hourglass puts a target on their backs.
A surprise visit from the Chief Inspector of the Night Bureau forces Mateo to hide Z-Blob,who goes on an adventure in the heart of Brooklyn.
Competing over who can ask Zoey to join their Sheep Week team,Logan cheats and unwittingly endangers the video game based Cyber Realm.
When the kids meddle in their teacher's dream to find test answers,they realize that in dreams,sweet little Ms. Putnam isn't so sweet… or little!

Using his Stone to Life magic the Cloud of Monstrox turns Clay into a living, fighting, breathing stone fighting knight. But will Clay use his forces to fight for good or for evil? Does he have a choice?

programmes.st: The Good, The Bad and The Tightwad
programmes.d: Clay wakes up in the poor town of Nothing Hill which literally has nothing. Will Clay remember who he is?
The NEXO KNIGHTS decide to use Clay to infiltrate the enemy camp. But first Clay needs to learn how to be a good spy.
Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox build a new stone army from giant building blocks to crush Knighton.
Jorah Tightwad is digging for gold but finds the ancient Lord Krakenskull buried with his army.
In order to stop Unagami, the ninja must obtain 3 Key-tanas, the first of which is hidden in Terra Karana–one of the most dangerous game environments.
The ninja climb the 'Cliffs of Hysteria and discover that Unagami is converting players into energy cubes to build a portal into the real world.

programmes.st: The Maze of the Red Dragon
programmes.d: Still in the game zone Terra Karana, Okino has to choose between helping his allies the ninja, or obeying the evil orders of his Master, Unagami.

programmes.st: One Step Forward, Two Steps Back
programmes.d: The ninja learn that the only way to acquire the 2nd Key-tana is by winning a race in Terra Technica and have to find racing cars in unexpected ways
As the ninja prepare for the brutal Speedway Five-Billion race, Lloyd meets a race driver named Seven who may hold the key to victory.
Unagami's soldiers, the Red Visors, finally discover the secret location of Scott's garage and attack the ninja.
Our ninja barely have time to mourn the loss of their fallen ninja friends before being thrust into the madness of Terra Domina.
Back in Ninjago City, Zane and Pixal hit the mean streets to track down Milton Dyer, only to discover that things are not what they seem...
Zane, kidnapped by the Mechanic, faces Unagami while Pixal questions Milton Dyer for information on how to shut down Prime Empire.
Jay must stand alone against Unagami in the end-game, yet Unagami has a bigger battle in facing the truth about his own identity.
Unagami breaks into the real world and terrorizes Ninjago City while Jay, Zane and Pixal attempt to prevent disaster by reuniting Unagami with Dyer.
The ninja are invited to attend the birthday party of Princess Vania in the Kingdom of Shintaro. They bring along Master Wu who is feeling his age.
Princess Vania reveals a secret entrance that leads to an underground mine beneath Shintaro where the city's dark secrets are held.
The ninja attempt to rescue Cole, but the bickering of his fellow prisoners  alerts the Skull Sorcerer, and soon the ninja are prisoners too.

By order of the Phoenix, King Laval, Cragger, Eris and their friends must defend a mysterious hill against the Hunter Tribes. They discover that the hill is strangely immune to the Hunters’ Ice Powers.
When the Tribes of Chima, armed with ample Fire Chi, launch a furious counter-assault against the Hunters, Fangar and his cohorts disappear underground.

Our heroes continue pushing back the Hunters with their Fire Chi-powered vehicles, but when they search the sites of the Hunters’ attacks, they can’t find any of the defeated animals. What has happened to them?
Laval and Li’Ella’s relationship grows as he gives her a tour of the Lion City. But distracted, he misses a key battle against the Hunters. Tormak joins the fight and saves the day.
In his father’s absence, Laval forced to take over as King of the Lion Tribe, … a role that does not suit him well. The Hunters launch yet another major attack on the Lion City.
“Laval tries to mount a rescue to save the Kings and Li’Ella, but Flinx accidentally thaws out Fangars trophy room, and they end up having to fight both the Hunters, Scorpions, Spiders, and Bats.“
Desperate to save his daughter, Tormak betrays the Phoenix and steals the Map known as the Artifact. But the theft does not go as planned.
Logan's desperation to prove himself leads to his capture by the Nightmare King,which leaves his friends to face the Sheep Week finals alone.
The Dream Chasers rush to save Logan from the Shadowkeep's dungeon,but the liberators soon become the prisoners in a nightmarish twist of fate.
A mysterious dome blocks Mateo and the others from leaving their dream landing, and Zoey and Albert are their only hope of escape.
With Albert captured by the Night Hunter and Z-Blob detained by Agent Strick, it's time for a dual rescue in the Waking World and the Dream World!
Detective Izzie takes the case of Mateo's missing comic book while Nova, the head of the Insomniacs, probes into a mystery of her own.
The hunt for the Sandman, the only one who can repair Lunia's hourglass, brings the kids to the dangerous Murky Realm, where memories go to die!

programmes.st: LEGO City Adventures For Wheeler/Brickmuda Heptagon
programmes.d: When Rooky discovers it's Chief Wheeler's birthday, she is determined to make it memorable. During the dedication ceremony of the city's deep-sea vessel to honor Duke, Freya, and Harl, the ship is accidentally set adrift.

programmes.st: LEGO City Adventures The Quacken/The Treasure of Nosepatch
programmes.d: When the mythical ocean monster, the Quacken, is sighted off the coast, famed adventurer Jessica Sharpe vows to capture it. Rooky and Grizzled go undercover aboard the Guardian of the Oceans in search of a lost pirate treasure.

programmes.st: LEGO City Adventures Arrest Ye Merry Gentleman/Ride Along Kid
programmes.d: When Fendrich threatens to ruin Sinclair's Holiday Gala, Duke intervenes to save both the party and the holidays! Freya takes Billy and Mark on a ride-along, but when things get out of hand, it's up to Mark to save the day.

programmes.st: LEGO City Adventures Midden Fleasure/Tread or Alive

A deathbed letter from an old friend puts the life of Ben Matlock in peril when he feels morally obligated to reopen a murder case more than three decades old.
A maid is accused of killing an employer.
Matlock’s client, a hot blues singer and compulsive gambler, is accused of murdering his boss/bookmaker, but Matlock discovers that a lot of people wanted the victim dead.
Defending a compulsive gambler accused of killing his bookie, Matlock uncovers an unsolved I5-year-old art theft and murder, as well as a blackmail scheme that followed the crime.

Viewing a heated argument from his hotel window, Matlock witnesses a murder involving two stars of a local theater production and an unhappy husband. When he helps investigate the case, his memory becomes a bit blurred.
Matlock runs into a series of high-level roadblocks when he goes to Washington to defend a popular columnist accused of murdering her source.
Matlock finds himself in a legal dilemma: his client stuns the courtroom with a confession, and then, saying that government agents had persuaded her to do so, tries to recant it.

A rare-coin dealer invests his trust in Matlock when he’s accused of murdering an employee who was caught stealing valuable coins. Meanwhile, Tyler becomes disgruntled when Matlock hires another private investigator, Linda Hansfield, to work on the case.
While defending a coin dealer accused of murdering an employee, Matlock and Tyler suspect the new investigator Ben hired, Linda Hansfield, is being blackmailed by the real killer.

The attraction is fatal! Matlock defends an obsessive suitor framed for allegedly murdering the love of his life, a dating service candidate so repelled by his presence that she had a restraining order to keep him away.
Ben Matlock is left with a lot of questions and no answers when his client, Drew Carey, bolts from the courtroom during a preliminary hearing for murder.
A philandering college professor is murdered in his classroom and Marcy Hansen is the prime suspect, having announced her pregnancy in an argument before witnesses.
Joining forces with an old friend and adversary, Julie March, Matlock attempts to reverse a murder sentence and unravel a case of corruption, conspiracy, and perjury.

Disagreeable London-based American businessman Albert Gordon is shot dead. His son Eric is the prime suspect. Believing Eric's innocent, sister Laura plans a mock trial hoping to uncover new evidence. Ben travels to London to defend Eric.
Matlock discovers he has more than enough suspects to go around for a murder which has the wrong man in jail.
It’s good news/bad news for Ben Matlock on the day he will be honored as Atlanta’s Man of the Year.
When testifying as a witness in a robbery case, Matlock is made to look like a fool. It soon becomes apparent that someone is playing tricks on him that threaten his credibility and safety.

The whereabouts of a list of enemy agents operating in the United States are locked in the memory of a captured spy, Col. Vanin (guest star Frank Marth), and no one, including the spy, can penetrate his mind in "The Party"

To locate a terrorist ring called Alpha Group, the IMF convinces turncoat intelligence agent Gordon Holt (played by guest star Peter Haskell) that he's been exposed to the stolen biological weapon he's been hired to deliver.
The IMF races a paid killer who is stalking a nuclear scientist forced by the enemy to work on a device that could upset the world power balance in the first of a two-part episode.
While trying to free a nuclear scientist and his wife from enemy hands, the IMF is trapped when a would-be assassin takes over one of Rollin's disguises in Part 2.
The IMF is called upon to end an inhuman situation which the United Nations has been unable to abolish: slave trade in the country of Elkabar, ruled by King Ibn Borca.
The IMF continues to battle slave-trading in a Middle Eastern country by eliminating De Groot, one of the principal suppliers of victims for King Borca's slave market.
Christopher George guest stars in the role of a psychotic ex-convict determined to wreak vengeance on society.
The IMF devises an elaborate scheme to dupe foreign agent James Reed into stealing a bogus missile guidance system in "The Missile"
Destroying a drug ring is the task of the IMF.
The imagination of the IMF is put to the test when a massive spy ring in the U.S. headed by fashion photographer, David Redding, threatens to cripple the country with a deadly pneumonic plague.
Guest star Jack Cassidy is Orin Kerr, an ex-hoodlum who now controls the largest gambling resort in the western hemisphere as a front for the underworld crime syndicate.

Stolen gems worth seventy-five million dollars scheduled to be fenced to an underworld figure suddenly disappear and the ship on which they were being transported is blown up at sea bringing the IMF team into the picture.

A dog that collects rare stamps -- on command from the IMF -- figures in a perilous journey to the stronghold of a narcotics kingpin (guest star Fernando Lamas) on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."
Cinnamon and Rollin become cabaret performers in a plot to get a deranged man (guest Fritz Weaver) to fall in love with Cinnamon, then kill her.
Guest star Bradford Dillman plays Edison, a former private detective turned extortionist who is blackmailing a powerful crime chief with a roll of film linking him to murder.
Elizabeth Ashley guest stars as a beautiful IMF agent who becomes the key to determining if enemy agent Nicholai Varsi is telling the truth when he claims he's defecting to the United States.

Christopher Connelly guest stars as a non-cooperative young computer genius who has "dropped out" of society, but is desperately needed by the IMF to complete their assignment on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

Mister Rogers uses scissors and talks about safety. Lady Elaine tells Officer Clemmons she won't return to the Neighborhood until King Friday changes his rule against play. Lou Schreiber, Johnny Costa, and Joe Negri play music together.
Mister Rogers visits a cave. Lady Elaine won't return until the no-play rule is changed. King Friday removes the ban when he realizes his fanfare cannot be played.

programmes.st: HURRY UP, LUFFY! SHIRAHOSHI'S LIFE IN JEOPARDY!
programmes.d: Shirahoshi summons the courage to risk everything to save her world, Luffy puts his own life in peril by venturing into the ocean, and Hordy's devious nature fully comes to the surface.

programmes.st: THE FIERCE FIGHT BEGINS! LUFFY VS. HORDY!
programmes.d: Luffy sets the stage for a final battle with Hordy, Sanji kicks a giant in defense of Nami's honor, and Zoro puts his blades to the ultimate test against a steroid-powered fighting fish!

programmes.st: A MASSIVE CONFUSED FIGHT! THE STRAW HATS VS. THE NEW FISHMAN PIRATES!
programmes.d: While Luffy and Shirahoshi try to prevent Fish-Man Island from being crushed, the rest of the Straw Hats square off against the meanest Fish-Man Pirates in the deep blue sea!

programmes.st: LUFFY LOSES THE FIGHT?! HORDY'S LONG-AWAITED REVENGE!
programmes.d: Luffy is the only one who can stop Hordy, but he'll need air to survive the fight, so Shirahoshi's big brother risks his own life in a heroic attempt to get Luffy a bigger bubble!

programmes.st: A SHOCKING FACT! THE TRUE IDENTITY OF HORDY!
programmes.d: While the rest of the Straw Hats continue to fight bravely, Luffy tries to find a way to save the island, and the horrible truth about Hordy's hatred for humans is finally revealed!

programmes.st: BACK TO ZERO! EARNEST WISHES FOR LUFFY!
programmes.d: Hordy's twisted past takes center stage in a Fish-Man flashback. Meanwhile, Shirahoshi's brother begs Luffy to save his beloved homeland and wipe out the anti-human element!

programmes.st: LUFFY'S ALL-OUT ATTACK! RED HAWK BLASTS!
programmes.d: Luffy's fist of fire puts Hordy down for the count, and the rest of the Straw Hats try to make short work of the remaining Fish-Man Pirates. Meanwhile, a very big boat looms overhead!

programmes.st: COMING TO AN END! THE FINAL DECISIVE BATTLE AGAINST HORDY!
programmes.d: While the rest of the Straw Hats try to make short work of their enemies, Luffy summons the strength for one last brutal attack on Hordy. Now, about that giant boat…

After defeating Hordy, Luffy turns his attention to stopping the Noah from crushing Fish-Man Island. Straw Hats and Fish-Men alike watch as Luffy tries to obliterate a boat with a barrage of brutal blows!

programmes.st: TO THE FUTURE! THE PATH TO THE SUN!
programmes.d: Fish-Man Island was saved by the timely arrival of the Sea Kings, but all is not well. Luffy lost a lot of blood in his battle with Hordy, and fish-to-human transfusions are strictly forbidden!

programmes.st: THE SECRET REVEALED! THE TRUTH ABOUT THE ANCIENT WEAPON!
programmes.d: Jimbei must decide whether or not to join the Straw Hats, and the grateful citizens of Fish-Man Island host a fabulous banquet in honor of their human heroes!

programmes.st: THE STRAW HATS STUNNED! THE NEW FLEET ADMIRAL OF THE NAVY!
programmes.d: Luffy and his crew learn of epic battle between Aokiji and Akainu, a forgotten foe tries to kidnap the mermaid princess, and Hordy's gang finally gets what's coming to them!

programmes.st: SHE LOVES SWEETS! BIG MOM OF THE FOUR EMPERORS!
programmes.d: When Luffy, Zoro, and Sanji stumble upon a couple of Big Mam's henchmen extorting sweets from the peaceful people of Fish-Man Island, the Straw Hats make a new – and very powerful – enemy!

programmes.st: MANY PROBLEMS LIE AHEAD! A TRAP AWAITING IN THE NEW WORLD!
programmes.d: The Straw Hats prepare to depart Fish-Man Island, a lion and a caribou come to blows over booby-trapped treasure, and Vice Admiral Smoker makes his presence felt in the New World!

programmes.st: FINALLY TIME TO GO! GOODBYE, FISHMAN ISLAND!
programmes.d: Luffy and his crew bid farewell to their new friends before setting off in search of the greatest adventures the New World has to offer!

programmes.st: TO THE NEW WORLD! HEADING FOR THE ULTIMATE SEA!
programmes.d: Luffy and Usopp's extreme deep sea fishing adventure lands the crew in the middle of a deadly whirlpool, but an unexpected encounter with a pod of giant whales may bail the Straw Hats out of hot water!

programmes.st: Z’s Ambition! Lily the Little Giant!
programmes.d: Luffy's arrival in the New World is marked by violent weather and the discovery of a tiny stowaway. When the Straw Hats  agree to help their new friend, it could lead to big trouble with the Marines!

programmes.st: Z’s Ambition! A Dark and Powerful Army!
programmes.d: Nami hatches a plan to save Lily's father, but the arrival of an ex-marine madman throws a monkey wrench into the rescue  mission.

programmes.st: Z’s Ambition! A Great and Desperate Escape Plan!
programmes.d: Luffy and Zoro find themselves locked in battle with their latest foes, but Nami's knowledge of the sea may be the key  to escaping this scrum alive!

Shuzo's squad of manned torpedoes targets the Straw Hats and the giants! The crazed captain tests Luffy's mettle in a  showdown on land, but the wily pirate pulls off a supersized surprise in hopes to stomp out the madman for good

programmes.st: Arriving! A Burning Island – Punk Hazard!
programmes.d: A desperate cry for help leads the Straw Hats to Punk Hazard, an island engulfed in flames and inhabited by a mythic  beast that could make short work of Luffy and the gang!

programmes.st: A Battle in the Heat! Luffy vs. the Giant Dragon!
programmes.d: Luffy and Zoro put their strength to the ultimate test in a battle with a dragon. Meanwhile, a band of mysterious  intruders make their gassy presence felt aboard the Sunny!

programmes.st: The Straw Hats Stunned! Enter: A Samurai’s Horrifying Severed Head!
programmes.d: Luffy gets up close and personal with a torso-less Samurai! Elsewhere, Nami, Sanji, Chopper, and Franky find themselves  imprisoned with the pieces of a human face!

programmes.st: Startling! The Secret of the Island Is Finally Revealed!
programmes.d: Luffy makes friends with a Centaur, Franky uses a cola-powered laser to break out of the clink, and Sanji takes a chance  on a body-less Samurai!

programmes.st: Save the Children! The Straw Hats Start to Fight!
programmes.d: Nami's soft spot for children prompts her to call off the escape and declare war on anyone who makes a kid cry.  Meanwhile, Luffy and the gang take a banana boat to the icy side of the island!

programmes.st: A Swordplay Showdown! Brook vs. the Mysterious Torso Samurai!
programmes.d: Luffy's group finds themselves up against a gang of centaurs, Brook battles the torso of a surly samurai, and Captain Smoker encounters someone highly unexpected!
Nami and Chopper seek a safe exit for the children, Luffy's group hopes to avoid a perilous plunge into icy waters, and  Captain Smoker faces off against Trafalgar Law!

programmes.st: In a Real Pinch! Luffy Sinks into the Ice-Cold Lake!
programmes.d: Luffy's group takes a deadly plunge into icy waters, and Trafalgar Law uses his unique abilities to rearrange Nami's  group and cast our heroes into chaotic confusion!

programmes.st: A Collision! Law vs. Vice Admiral Smoker!
programmes.d: While Luffy and his mates race toward a reunion, Admiral Smoker struggles to survive a heart-stopping showdown with Trafalgar Law!

programmes.st: Meeting Again After Two Years! Luffy and Law!
programmes.d: Luffy is excited to once again cross paths with Trafalgar Law, but a reunion with his mixed up crew – and the loss of his extra legs – quickly dampens the captain's enthusiasm!

programmes.st: The Worst in the World! A Scientist of Terror - Caesar!
programmes.d: While Captain Smoker determines his next move, a very large pirate with alligator legs tells Luffy and the Straw Hats the true story of Punk Hazard's mysterious transformation!

programmes.st: History’s Strongest Collaboration vs. Glutton of the Sea
programmes.d: In the aftermath of Toriko, Luffy, and Goku's three-way tie in the World's Best Eating Competition, the festivities are interrupted by the sudden appearance of a monster that threatens to consume every living thing on earth.

programmes.st: Chopper's Fury! The Master's Inhumane Experiment!
programmes.d: The giant children fly into a mysterious rage, and Chopper discovers the true reason for their unusual condition! Meanwhile, Zoro, Brook, and Sanji cross paths with a dangerous duo!

When tasked with hauling the old animatronic band, Rock-A-Fire Explosion, Jenn ends up pulling a Yoko Ono and almost cancels their reunion tour.
After the delivery of sad family news, Jenn turns to Jarrett to take over an odd shipment.

Team Salvage is tasked with removing a broken down tractor from a Caravan Park in trouble with the law and Luke responds to an unlucky boat owner in desperate need of help.

A wedding-bound Roy arrives at a Guelph auction in his tuxedo.

programmes.d: With Bogart on crutches and Cindy nursing a cold, it’s a tough day at the auction for all the buyers in Guelph.
Excitement runs high as Mississauga plays host to a charity auction of highend storage crates.

Team Salvage is on a back-to-back muddy monster machine SOS in the Northern Territory.

New insights on Nolan Cross suggest a Templar connection to the Money Pit while emerging, hard evidence convinces the team the discovery of the lead cross may be the most historic find in North America.
In Smith's Cove, the Laginas struggle to hold back the waters.

programmes.st: Let That Be Your Last Battlefield
programmes.d: The Enterprise hosts two alien beings from the same planet who share an intense and self-destructive hatred of each other.
Kirk beams down on a diplomatic mission. He finds himself on an Enterprise where all the crew has vanished, and only a mysterious woman resides.
Kirk, McCoy, and Sulu are stranded on a barren planet where a mysterious woman attempts to kill them one at a time, while the Enterprise must travel halfway across the galaxy to rescue them.
The Enterprise must deal with incorporeal cloud-like aliens who have already destroyed the inhabitants of a library planet.
While seeking a cure for a fever ravaging the Enterprise, Kirk and Spock encounter Flint, a hermit-like Earthman, and his beautiful young ward.
The Enterprise picks up a group of space "hippies" looking for Eden.
To acquire the resources to cure a space plague, Kirk must resolve a mining dispute between the cultural elites of the cloud city of Stratos and the miners on the surface.
Kirk and Spock meet Abraham Lincoln and Surak of Vulcan and must battle with some of history's most terrible villains.
Kirk, Spock, and McCoy enter a time portal and get stuck in the past on a planet about to be consumed by a nova.
The Enterprise is in danger when Janice Lester, one of Kirk's former lovers, steals his body.
Kirk and his crew are at deadly risk from an alien creature that feeds on the salt in a human body and can take on any form.
A powerful teenage boy wreaks havoc aboard the U.S.S. Enterprise.

programmes.st: Where No Man Has Gone Before
programmes.d: Kirk's friend, Gary Mitchell, is transformed into a God-like entity.
A strange alien substance causes the crew to act out their deepest inhibitions, while the ship plummets out of orbit.

A transporter malfunction causes Captain Kirk to split into his "good" and "evil" selves, and a landing party will freeze to death if the crew is unable to find a way to merge the two Kirks back together.
The Enterprise picks up a intergalactic conman, Harry Mudd, and three incredibly beautiful women who harbor a dark secret.

programmes.st: What Are Little Girls Made Of?
programmes.d: Nurse Christine Chapel is reunited with her old fiancé on Exo III, but the scientist has plans for Captain Kirk and the Federation.
While Worf and Ezri face execution, an alliance between enemies threatens to turn the tide of the war against the Federation.
The war reaches a crucial turning point when the Cardassian leader breaks from the Dominion- Breen alliance.
While Kira consults with Damar's rebel forces, Bashir makes a shocking discovery about the disease ravaging the Founders.
Kira masterminds a plot to obtain an enemy weapon, while Worf investigates a dramatic power shift within the Klingon Empire.
Bashir and O'Brien link minds with the man who holds the cure to Odo's deadly disease.
With the Cardassian Resistance crushed, the Federation war against the Dominion reaches the prelude to one final showdown.
The war against the Dominion reaches its final confrontation when Sisko leads the Federation Alliance in an attempt to invade the homeworld.
The war against the Dominion reaches its final confrontation when Sisko leads the Federation Alliance in an attempt to invade the homeworld.
On a distant outpost, an untested crew embarks on an unprecedented journey.
On a distant outpost, an untested crew embarks on an unprecedented journey.

Odo, the station's mysterious, gruff and yet incredibly fair shape-shifter constable, falls under suspicion for a Bajora's baffling murder -- and xenophobic hatred rears its ugly head in the station's rush to judgment.

Kira has barely gotten to know her new DS9 colleagues or settled in as a "legitimate" officer of post-occupation Bajor when she has to confront an old fellow freedom fighter who can't give up the fight.
An aphasia-like virus planted in DS9's food replicator system by the Bajoran underground against their onetime oppressors lies dormant until being activated during refurbishment.
The first two species to visit through the wormhole are hardly ceremonial: one, described only as "Tosk," is being hunted in a formal, ritualized sport that both he and his pursuers enjoy.

Famed for their encounters with Capt. Picard, John deLancie guest stars as pesky super-alien "Q" and Jennifer Hetrick reprises her romantic rogue archeologist Vash -- last seen on TNG headed for the Gamma Quadrant.
The nature of Trill symbiosis is explored when a Klaestron commando legal team tries to kidnap Jadzia Dax for alleged treason committed by Curzon, the prior Dax host.
The master Kobliad criminal-scientist Rao Vantika is presumed dead after an inmate transport fire, but his wily pursuer Ty Kajada is not so sure.
Archer and his crew encounter a group of alien hunters upon a rogue planet that has broken out of its orbit.
The entire Enterprise crew is knocked unconscious by a plundering Ferengi crew through a Trojan horse gas canister, leaving the ship to be easily ransacked.
Exploring a crashed ship on a desolate planet, Trip finds the stranded crew still alive despite the seemingly insurmountable odds, but something about them isn't quite right.
Wrongfully imprisoned for ignorantly trespassing, Archer and Mayweather are taken prisoner by the Tandarans and find themselves in a Suliban internment camp.

From a visiting alien ship, a fibrous, web-like creature secures itself inside an Enterprise launch bay and ensnares several crewmen. Hoshi must work to learn the creature's bizarre language in order to save the trapped crewmen.
Archer must delay the crew's much-needed shore leave to transport a Vulcan Ambassador from her planet of Mazar to rendezvous with a Vulcan ship.
Archer and Trip aid a disabled vessel and, in gratitude for their assistance, the vessel's captain invites the two officers to dinner in his desert-landscape village on his nearby home planet.
Finally arriving at the paradise of planet Risa, the Enterprise crew is able to enjoy two days and nights of much needed shore leave.
The temporal cold war heats us as Captain Archer is taken to the 31st century by the Sulibans.

As Archer makes his way back from the 31st century to prevent the Sulibans destroying the Enterprise, his crew tries to fend off the violent machinations and interrogations of leader Silik and come up with their own plan to keep the ship safe.

T'Pol relates a tale of the Vulcans real First Contact when she claims that a relative of hers crash-landed in Carbon Creek, Pennsylvania in 1957, mingled with the townsfolk, and rescued workers in a mining accident.

When Enterprise is struck by a soon-to-detonate weapon and lodges in the ship's hull, Reed must deactivate it, but his subsequent injury and a group of encroaching Romulans bent on destruction force Archer think creatively to save the crew and ship.

To facilitate a lengthy list of necessary repairs, the crew visits an alien station with a super-computer that can fix anything.  But the automated station's demands for payment seem too good to be true...until Mayweather is discovered dead.
Archer spends a sleepless night tending to his quarantined beagle Porthos and figuring out how to apologize to the quirky, ritualistic Kreetassens he inadvertently offended on a recent visit.
Archer feels compelled to help a rustic alien colony that finds their rich resources constantly dwindling due to the Klingons' pillaging ways.

Assigned to track down a Vulcan fugitive she lost 17 years ago, T'Pol enlists Archer and Mayweather's help in retrieving him, but finding the criminal triggers mysterious, deadly memories she has trouble resolving.

When Reed accidentally loses his communicator during a visit to a pre-Warp culture, he and Archer must retrieve it, but when they do, they are mistaken for spies and are faced with the threat of execution.
The Enterprise searches for answers as to why three Klingon warriors were the only survivors aboard a freighter just inside the Neutral Zone which was seemingly attacked by a Ferengi ship.
The Enterprise encounters a planet long dead, but technical equipment still functions for the purpose of selling off its arsenal, along with self sufficiency.
The Enterprise encounters two neighboring cultures, one suffering from a plague, the other marketing a cure, and learn that nothing is as simple as it seems.
While en route back to the Enterprise, the shuttlecraft carrying Counselor Troi loses power and gets caught in a planet's gravity well.
The crew of the Enterprise races against time, itself, when a scientist experiments with time, and claims to have opened a window into another dimension, which must be closed.

After diverting to a secret meeting with an old friend and some of Starfleet's finest commanders, Picard finds the Horatio blown to bits just hours after the meeting and he returns the Enterprise to Earth looking for answers.
While assigned to investigate missing outposts in the Neutral Zone, the Enterprise revives three cryogenically frozen people found aboard a wayward derelict Earth vessel.
Deanna is impregnated by an unknown alien life-form, and Dr. Katherine Pulaski joins the Enterprise as the ship's new Chief Medical Officer.
The Enterprise encounters a mysterious void in space and when they move in closer to investigate further, it envelops them and they can't get out.
When the Enterprise arrives a few days early at its rendezvous point to meet the USS Victory, the crew have a bit of leisure time on their hands.
The Enterprise rescues the captain of a broken-down freighter, only to become involved in a dispute between feuding worlds--each demanding custody of their guest.
The crew ferries a deaf mediator to Solais V to negotiate an end to a civil war.
The Enterprise responds to a request for medical assistance from Dr. Ira Graves, considered by many to be the greatest living mind in the universe.

The Enterprise is en route to Star Station India when received a distress signal from the USS Lantree, a Federation supply ship. When they arrive, they find everyone aboard the Lantree of what seems to be old age.
When the Federation promotes an officer exchange program, Commander Riker decides to accept an assignment aboard a Klingon war ship.

When Data resigns his commission rather than be dismantled for examination by an inadequately skilled scientist, a formal hearing is convened to determine whether Data is considered property without rights or is a sentient being.
Ens. Wesley Crusher suffers from the pangs of first love when the Enterprise is tasked to transport a young woman, Salia, back to her home where she is to become the leader of her people.
The Voyager crew has been abducted and brainwashed to serve as workers in a severely short-handed industrial alien society.
To save Janeway and the rest of Voyager's crew, Chakotay must convince her that her seemingly happy life as a worker on Quarra is not real.
Seven's attempt to explore her human side distracts her from her duties and puts Voyager at risk.
Q's unruly and omnipotent son wreaks interstellar havoc when he is left in Janeway's care.
The Doctor publishes a holo-novel based on his Voyager experiences which scandalizes the crew.
Voyager recovers a long-lost space probe which has caused terrible radiation damage on a distant planet.
Seven and Chakotay stumble upon a race of primitive humanoids isolated from technological progress by an energy barrier.
Neelix is faced with the decision of a lifetime when Voyager locates a tribe of exiled Talaxians on a distant asteroid.
Janeway is held hostage by aliens who force the Doctor to help them steal Voyager's warp core.
Voyager's quest to return home is aided by a visitor from the future – Admiral Kathryn Janeway.
Janeway risks Voyager's shortcut home in order to destroy the Borg and save millions of lives.
While searching for a missing officer, Captain Kathryn Janeway and the crew of the Starship Voyager are swept 70,000 light years from home.
The Voyager crew launches a daring rescue mission to save two officers trapped in a subterranean city facing disaster.
Tensions rise between the merged Starfleet and Maquis crews when the ship becomes trapped inside a star that's collapsed upon itself.
When Paris and Janeway are sent back in time, they must decide whether to violate the Prime Directive by warning residents of a planet facing annihilation.
Neelix faces certain death when an alien race stricken by a devastating plague "harvests" his lungs.
The crew discovers that a nebula is not what it seems, and Paris invites his fellow officers to share a little "R&R" in his holodeck program.

Stargate SG-1’s Dr. Daniel Jackson (Michael Shanks) travels to Atlantis when his research suggests that a rebellious Ancient scientist named Janus (Gildart Jackson) may have hidden a secret lab somewhere within the city.

Jackson and McKay have reactivated the Attero device, an ancient machine designed to annihilate the Wraith. In doing so, they discover the reason the device was ultimately abandoned… Meanwhile, Todd continues to hold the Daedalus crew captive.

Col. Sheppard and his team locate Dr. Carson Beckett on an alien planet where he is treating a small group of survivors of the Hoffan plague. But that same evening, a party of Wraith warriors arrives, threatening total annihilation.

A newly formed galactic coalition extends an invitation to Lt. Col. John Sheppard and his team to represent Atlantis at their next meeting. But on arrival, the team is immediately detained and must stand trial for crimes against humanity.

Atlantis is suddenly plunged into darkness, with only the top tier of the central tower unaffected. As Sheppard and McKay attempt to get to the top level, they discover that a force field has been established to prevent them from gaining access.

While Richard Woolsey (Robert Picardo) struggles to keep his position as the leader of Atlantis, and McKay (David Hewlett) and Zelenka (David Nykl) investigate a mysterious find, Sheppard is captured by an old enemy with plans to invade the city.

When the Atlantis team is given two weeks of vacation leave, Dr. Rodney McKay reluctantly accepts an invitation by his former rival, Malcolm Tunney, to attend a scientific demonstration that he claims will be the solution to global warming.

With the Destiny still out of power, a plan is born to abandon the ship using the last working shuttle, in hopes that another planet will be habitable. But hope is short-lived when the only way to determine who will go and who will stay is a lottery.

Despite severe rationing and around-the-clock security, the water reserves onboard the Destiny continue to drop. Dr. Nicholas Rush has no explanation for this latest setback but, if they are to survive, they must find a new water source soon.

With the situation onboard the Destiny dire, General O’Neill (Richard Dean Anderson) and Homeworld Command order Col. Young to execute a high-risk plan concocted by the IOA scientists which, in theory, could return the crew to Earth.

After making a surprising discovery on a jungle planet, members of the team become ill. In an attempt to isolate the infection, the team sets up camp in the jungle. But when night falls, the illness will be the least of their worries.

On the mysterious planet Argos, the beautiful Kynthia seduces Colonel Jack O'Neill, which means he's condemned to an Argosian lifespan of only a hundred days. As he turns gray, will his team succeed in their frantic search for a cure?

Looking for allies against the Goa'uld, the SG-1 team lands on Cimmeria, home of the legendary Norse gods. Teal'c and O'Neill are transported to an underground labyrinth of caves of the vicious creature Unas. Can Carter & Daniel rescue them?

Dr. Daniel Jackson discovers that in 1945, a young professor slipped through the Stargate, never to return. Together with his still living fiancée, the SG-1 team discovers the now aged professor trapped in a decaying fortress.

With the proviso that he bring back a Goa'uld larva for study, Teal'c (Christopher Judge) returns to Chulak to stop the Goa'uld from enslaving his son Rya'c. Trouble is, Rya'c needs a larva to survive - and the only one available is Teal'c's.

The SG-1 team returns from the planet Oannes in a panic and minus Daniel Jackson, who was last seen being consumed by a column of flames. But as his comrades mourn him on Earth, Daniel is the captive of an amphibious humanoid creature known as Nem.

The evil Goa'uld Hathor (Suanne Braun) escapes from a Mayan pyramid in Mexico. At the Stargate facility, she uses her charms to seduce the men into helping her take over the world. Can Samantha Carter and her female colleagues defeat her?

At the urging of Honey Pie Pony, Strawberry & Friends decide to put on a Cooking Show.

The Berry Blossom Festival is underway and everyone in Strawberryland is having a Grand Time, thanks to the selfless efforts of Strawberry Shortcake.
Strawberry and her friends love to dance – and the Peculiar Purple Pieman of Porcupine Peak is taking advantage of that!
It’s winter and the pond’s frozen and that means Strawberry and friends can ice skate!

When the town’s very formal Berry Bitty Buggy Derby is revived, the girls are unfamiliar with the traditional behavior for the event.
Chaos ensues when Raspberry finds a way to enlarge the Berrykins to the same size as Strawberry and her friends.

After an accidental wager with Purple Pieman, Strawberry sets off to prove that she can go around the world in 80 days.
One night, as Strawberry & Friends gaze at the stars, they talk about what they want to be when they grow up.

Annie Oatmeal hires both Strawberry Shortcake and Angel Cake to work at her dude ranch.

When the town needs a larger venue for their upcoming Glimmerberry Ball, Plum finds an ideal hollow tree for the occasion.
