Brace for pure sonic devastation! Featuring relentless blast beats, guttural vocals, and razor-sharp riffs, this collection captures the raw intensity and uncompromising brutality of death metal at its absolute peak. Prepare for impact!

Where rock 'n' roll swagger meets the weight of metal. This collection bridges the gap, featuring everything from anthemic hard rock to core-shaking classics. It’s loud, it’s proud, and it’s built to move you.

Dive into pure power and unrelenting energy. Endless Heavyness is a non-stop wall of sound designed to hit hard and stay loud. No pauses, no compromises—just the most massive tracks to keep the momentum going. It’s not just loud; it’s eternal.

programmes.t: From The Scene For The Scene
programmes.d: Go beyond the music and into the heart of the underground. This collection pairs heavy-hitting videos with exclusive band interviews and reports from metal capitals worldwide. Built by the scene, for the scene.
Liam Neeson stars as the legendary hero who refused to let his enemies destroy his honor.
Nicholas Nickleby sets off on an adventure to reunite his broken family in Dickens' beloved novel come to life
A judge (Spencer Tracy) presides over the trial of four German jurists accused of "legalizing" Nazi atrocities
Burt Lancaster stars as Robert Stroud, who spent 43 years in solitary confinement at Alcatraz.
A traveling salesman discovers he can hustle money in a Evangelical tent-show as easily as in a saloon.
A former thief and a brash young drifter team up to pull off the perfect heist in this bold crime thriller!
A master safe cracker plans one last heist for the sake of a woman...and a whole new life.

programmes.t: To Live And Die In L.A.
programmes.d: Federal agent Richard Chance vows to take down a murderous counterfeiter by any means necessary.
Two convicts run an ingenious bank robbery scheme...until they meet an eccentric housewife.
Action-packed spy thriller about mercenaries out to steal a top-secret briefcase for a mysterious client.
Boxer Jake La Motta's life is filled with violence both in out of the ring in this masterpiece.
A tough and conservative security guard seeks out his drag queen neighbor for help to recover from a stroke
Two best friends in 1964 Chicago cope with the challenges of everyday life and life in the housing projects.
Join Caractacus Potts and his magical, flying automobile for a trip to classic family fun!
This lavish musical is the story of a poor man whose love and faith help him face oppression.
Will Smith is a charming stranger who penetrates the world of a wealthy couple and alters their lives forever!

Two hapless soldiers of misfortune (Chuck Norris, Louis Gossett Jr.) meet a beautiful girl (Melody Anderson) with a map to a lost gold mine and decide to have one last shot at striking it rich. But the trail to the treasure is no yellow brick road!

Breaker! Breaker! stars Chuck Norris at his butt-kicking best as a trucker on a mission to locate his kidnapped brother and bring down a corrupt Judge (George Murdock) who may just have played a role in the disappearance.
The legendary Clark Gable and Burt Lancaster star in this gripping, classic military drama aboard a submarine.

Screen greats Burt Lancaster, Paul Scofield and Jeanne Moreau star in this suspense-laden tale of justice and retribution as a French Resistance fighter (Lancaster) attempts to stop a Nazi commander from looting the art treasures of Paris.
As the Korean War rages, Lieutenant Joe Clemons (Gregory Peck) finds himself standing at a crossroad.
After the "Westworld" disaster, the Delos corporation is back, this time with "Futureworld!" But the resort might not be as safe as Delos claims…

programmes.t: The Adventures Of Buckaroo Banzai Across The 8th Dimension
programmes.d: In this cult classic, neurosurgeon, physicist and rock star Buckaroo Banzai (Peter Weller) is ready to save the world when the evil Red Lectroids -- led by the deranged Lord John Whorfin (John Lithgow) -- are unleashed from the 8th dimension.
American servicemen are still being held captive in Vietnam – and it's up to one man to bring them home in this blistering, fast-paced action/adventure starring martial arts superstar Chuck Norris.

Chuck Norris returns as James Braddock in this action-packed prequel to the original hit film. As war rages in Vietnam, Braddock and his men are captured and imprisoned. With fists and sheer courage, he must become an army of one to save his men.

When Colonel James Braddock (Chuck Norris, "Missing in Action") is told that his wife and 12-year-old son are still alive in Communist Vietnam, he mounts a one-man assault to free them…armed with the latest high-tech firepower, of course!

Political extremists have taken innocent people hostage…and only super-soldiers Chuck Norris, Lee Marvin and The Delta Force can rescue them in this explosive adventure filled with wall-to-wall action! Martin Balsam and Shelley Winters also star.

Chuck Norris is in peak form in this explosive action/adventure that brings back one of his most unforgettable characters, Delta Force Colonel Scott McCoy, for a daring mission to destroy a deadly drug cartel led by the ruthless Billy Drago!

Michael Dudikoff stars as Joe Armstrong, a one-man fighting machine. Serving in the army to avoid prison, Joe finds himself battling the deadly Black Star Order, as well as corrupt military leaders in order to bring down an illegal arms sale.

In this action-packed sequel, Joe Armstrong and Curtis Jackson are sent to the Caribbean in search of missing Marines. But they must first battle scientifically engineered Super Ninjas to bring down a dreaded drug lord known as The Lion!

Martial artist David Bradley takes the reins as Sean Davidson in this third installment of the wildly popular "American Ninja" franchise, teaming up with Steve James to battle a maniacal terrorist in yet another explosive action-packed adventure!

Michael Dudikoff is back in action in this thrilling sequel! Teamed up with CIA operative Sean Davidson (David Bradley), Joe Armstrong (Dudikoff) returns to help foil the plans of a terrorist (James Booth) hell-bent on annihilating New York City.
Tommy Gibbs (Fred Williamson) grows up to become the reigning head of Harlem's black mafia.
Recovering from an onslaught of bullets that would have killed a lesser man, the Godfather of Harlem, Tommy Gibbs, is back and is out for revenge.
Action legends return to the genre that made them famous in this big, brassy and action-packed tale!

A drifter (Don Johnson) moves into a small town and into a torrid affair with a local woman (Virginia Madsen). But when he falls in love with someone else (Jennifer Connelly), he finds himself trapped in a dangerous web of revenge and murder!

Under the guise of a witch-hunt, the notorious "witch hunter" Matthew Hopkins and his henchmen ravage and plunder a lawless England. Innocent men and women are tortured and put to death for being witches...but one man is determined to stop them.
Christopher Lee plays the Lord Chief Justice of 17th century England who condemns women as witches to further his political and sexual needs.

Norman Taylor has been enjoying unusual success at work lately, but could it be due to the magic his wife practices in secret? Infuriated upon discovering her methods, he destroys her protective spells, putting both their lives in mortal danger.

programmes.t: The Fall Of The House Of Usher (1960)
programmes.d: For the Ushers, their house is more than just a home...it’s their tomb…as Vincent Price goes to ghastly lengths to end his family's bloodline forever.
Happily-ever-after goes under the knife in this horror classic, a saga of murder, madness and forbidden desire.
Three short stories based on the works of Edgar Allan Poe, with Vincent Price in the starring roles and directed by the great Roger Corman.
Scream legends Vincent Price, Peter Lorre and Boris Karloff are three rival sorcerers whose paths cross when one is turned into a raven by another!
A century after a warlock was burned alive, his descendant (Vincent Price) inherits the family estate and the horrors of the past return to haunt him.

programmes.t: The Masque Of The Red Death (1964)
programmes.d: Death and debauchery reign in the castle of Price Prospero (Vincent Price)...and when it reigns it pours...in this lavish Edgar Allan Poe adaptation.
Vincent Price's deceased first wife, Ligeia, casts a long shadow over his ill-advised second marriage, especially when Ligeia’s spirit returns.
The legendary Vincent Price turns in another classic performance in this intelligent and grim thriller about a magistrate who just might be possessed.

The eminent Dr. Phibes (Vincent Price) awakens from a decade of suspended animation and heads to Egypt with the corpse of his dead wife. Which he intends to resurrect by murdering people in strange and heinous ways to invoke a magical incantation!
Vincent Price is a crazed Shakespearean actor who adds murder to his repertoire when he takes gruesome revenge on the critics who slighted him.

Gather around the campfire....to die! After a cruel joke severely disfigures him, camp caretaker Cropsy is back -- with hedge clippers in hand -- seeking revenge on those who scarred him! Can the campers save themselves before he kills them all?

Lefty Enright (Dennis Hopper) seeks to avenge the murder of his kin by Leatherface, Chop-Top, The Cook and Grandpa. With the help of a radio DJ he finds his way to their underground slaughter shop, where a battle of epic proportions will soon rage.

In this cult-classic zom-com, two totally awesome Valley Girls (Catherine Mary Stewart, Kelli Maroney) kick some zombie butt and go on the lam from bloodthirsty scientists after a passing comet turns all of Los Angeles into the walking undead!

The Vicious Lips get a shot to make it as the galaxy's next big musical act, but their hopes soon come crashing back to earth. Hastily signing up the wide-eyed Judy Jetson to front the band, the Lips blast off on their meteoric rise to superstardom.
On a quiet, tree-lined street, evil has arrived through an old television set when killer zombies crawl out of a horror film and into suburbia!

Scientist Patrick Corey has a hideous hobby - he keeps brains alive! But when the brain of dead murderer W.H. Donovan falls into his possession, he finds that it has a mind of its own�and is controlling him through telepathic messages!

To restore the life of his fiancee, who was decapitated in an automobile accident, a brilliant surgeon tries to find a suitable body to attach to her head, which he keeps alive and locked in a dungeon. But nothing will stop her from getting revenge!

programmes.t: The Monster That Challenged The World
programmes.d: The beaches go from fun-filled swim-fests to horrifying slug-fests when gargantuan vampire snails threaten to suck the life out of all mankind!
An American reporter in Japan becomes the unwitting subject of a mad scientist’s twisted experiment in this terrifying tale of ambition gone berserk.

programmes.t: It! The Terror From Beyond Space
programmes.d: Panic is rampant in this acclaimed thriller about a band of space explorers who suddenly find themselves being hunted by a maniacal creature.
One of the great horror anthology films, and director Mario Bava's personal favorite of his works, "Black Sabbath" tells three short tales of horror.

Lee Marvin gives a spellbinding performance as Harry Spikes, a wounded outlaw who appears as a romantic figure to three impressionable youths (Gary Grimes, Ron Howard and Charles Martin Smith) and who he enlists them as his bank-robbing partners.
Screen icons Kirk Douglas, Robert Mitchum and Richard Widmark star in this in this sumptuous epic as pioneers who travel the treacherous Oregon trail.

Director John Sturges presents a reworking of the Wyatt Earp/Doc Holliday legend and the struggle for political control of Tombstone, with a marvelous trio of antagonists: James Garner as Earp, Jason Robards as Holliday, and Robert Ryan as Clanton.

In this action-packed western, ex-pat Martin Brady (Robert Mitchum) travels to Texas to broker an arms deal for Mexican Governor Castro (Pedro Armendariz). But things get complicated when the the guns he was returning to Mexico are stolen.

In this gun-slinging adventure, an aging lawman (Robert Mitchum) teams up with Young Billy Young (Robert Walker), a fast-draw outlaw on the run. But it's an alliance that explodes when the lawman discovers a secret that could rip two towns apart!
In this western, a man riding out for revenge against the man who killed his brother instead comes across the killer's own brother…who is blind.
Attempting to affect peace between his men and the Apaches, the commander of a fort unwittingly inspires an Indian massacre.

Screen Legends Kirk Douglas and Walter Matthau co-star in this exciting account of a man who made his name fighting Indians, but who now must use his peacekeeping skills to keep wronged Sioux warriors from exacting vengeance upon a nearby fort.

Eli Wakefield (Burt Lancaster) and his son are Kentucky adventurers longing for life on the Texas frontier. They learn, however, that their greatest challenge lies not in the uncharted wilderness, but in the people they meet along the way.

In this epic Western, two shady mercenaries (Gary Cooper, Burt Lancaster) in Mexico during the 1866 revolution are hired to escort a Countess and her gold to the Mexican army in Vera Cruz and find themselves at odds with the army... and each other!

John Huston directs Audrey Hepburn in this thrilling, romantic western about a woman who becomes the target of lawless racism and brutality when it is discovered that she was born to the Kiowa tribe but secretly adopted by a white frontier family.

Sydney Pollack directs Burt Lancaster, Shelley Winters, Ossie Davis and Telly Savalas in this lively and ribald western about a frontier-wise fur trapper who loses his pelts to a band of Kiowas in exchange for a slave he doesn't want.

In this rousing Western, when a greedy rancher causes the death of an innocent man, former sheriff Bob Valdez (Burt Lancaster) orders him to provide financial support for the widow. But when he refuses, Valdez vows to exact justice at any cost!

In Michael Winner's unique take on the western, a sheriff (Burt Lancaster) is determined to bring to justice a rancher (Lee J. Cobb) and his hands who accidentally killed an old man during a drunken spree. Robert Ryan and Robert Duvall co-star.

John Wayne, Montgomery Clift and Walter Brennan give stellar performances in Howard Hawks' epic masterpiece as a self-made cattle baron (Wayne) and his adopted son (Clift) risk everything to drive their herd across the treacherous Chisholm Trail.
John Wayne teams with William Holden and director John Ford for this rousing tale of one of the most daring cavalry exploits in all of history.

John Wayne produces, directs and stars in this retelling of the Alamo, a battle in which 185 men joined together against an army of 7,000. Filmed entirely in Texas, "The Alamo" is a visually stunning and historically accurate celebration of courage.

When a peaceful mission to move the Sioux to reservations turns into an ambitious general's vicious vendetta, a captain and his cavalry recruits are led towards a bloody fate. Written by Sam Peckinpah and starring Tom Tryon and Harve Presnell.
Chaos reigns on the wide open plains as Burt Lancaster and Lee Remick let loose in this comedy that spoofs nearly every convention of movie westerns.

The body has inherent systems to slow and even reverse aging. When you activate these systems you increase stem cell production, reduce inflammation, increase antioxidant enzymes, build muscle, lose fat, and increase cognitive capacity.

Now that we understand the root causes of aging, how do we actually address the hallmarks of aging? What are the levers we have to optimize our health and longevity? Because medicine has it all wrong. We don't need to treat disease. When we focus on fostering optimal health, disease goes away as a side effect.

There are basic fundamental ways we can optimize our health, starting with topics we’ve already discussed, like eating well and exercising appropriately. But, just as important for health and longevity is the need to rest, relax, and connect with each other. Community is essential, and being of service to one another can help you heal.

Too much stress will take you down, but the right amount of stress at the right time can activate your body's repair and healing mechanisms. What natural elements stress our system in such a way that it then activates the body to heal?

programmes.t: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programmes.d: Grief is the death of something—someone, a relationship, a job, or a dream. There’s no timeline, and you cannot heal what you do not feel. Guided by David Kessler, this course helps you navigate your river of grief, honor your unique process, and find a path toward healing.

programmes.t: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programmes.d: Grief is about the heart, but the mind shapes the story we tell. While you can’t change the facts of loss, you can change the narrative, honor old wounds, and choose words that guide you toward growth, meaning, and deeper connection to joy and healing.

programmes.t: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programmes.d: Loss can make you feel powerless, but grief is your work and your power. David Kessler guides you to grieve fully on your terms, honor your unique process, and reclaim agency over your healing, showing that you can live fully while holding your pain with strength.

programmes.t: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programmes.d: Your survival mind is wired to protect you from pain, but after loss it can spiral into worry and worst-case thinking. Learn the science of grief, how repetitive thoughts form deep mental pathways, and how to rewire your mind to heal and grow.

Day 1 introduces the practice of centering through the breath. When the mind drifts to regret or worry, we gently return—again and again. This meditation teaches concentration, presence, and compassion, reminding us that healing isn’t in never wandering, but in beginning again.

Day 2 invites us to examine the stories we tell about our worth, limits, and lives. By recognizing conditioned habits and outdated coping tools, we reconnect with our power of choice. This lesson reminds us that change is always possible—and that we can meet life with renewed care and curiosity.

Day 3 focuses on meeting anger and fear with compassion rather than resistance. By paying gentle attention to difficult emotions, we learn they are not bad—only painful when they define us. Using the breath as an anchor, we develop a kinder, wiser relationship to our inner experience.

Day 4 explores opening to joy by intentionally taking in the good. We examine habits of threat, perfectionism, and resistance, and practice savoring what’s nourishing and life-giving. Through gentle curiosity, this lesson shows how joy can restore resilience and help us meet life with more ease.

La investigación señaló a su propia madre, María Preselia Martínez, como responsable del crimen, motivado presuntamente por la pérdida de una sim card. Fue condenada por homicidio agravado y cumple su condena en la cárcel de mujeres La Badea, en Pereira.

En Florencia, Caquetá, Lina, embarazada de siete meses, fue asesinada frente a su casa. Aunque el sicario escapó, un testigo señaló a Marmolejo, pareja de la víctima y padre de su bebé, como el autor intelectual del crimen. Pruebas contundentes, incluyendo el testimonio del propio pistolero, confirman que Marmolejo contrató el asesinato para deshacerse de Lina y estar con otra mujer.

Tras varias hipótesis, se descubrió que su propio hermano, Juan Carlos, contrató sicarios para matarlos, motivado por la codicia y el deseo de convertirse en el único heredero de sus bienes.
Heidy Guzmán, de 10 años, desapareció en Tolima en 2007. Fue hallada sin vida tras dos semanas. La investigación reveló abuso y homicidio.

Jessica Mayerli Alza, una estudiante de 16 años, es hallada desmembrada dentro de una maleta en el sur de Bogotá. Un año después, Andrea Valdez Contreras fue condenada a 345 meses de prisión por homicidio agravado.

Annie demanda a su ex mejor amiga Olivia por 150.000 dólares de angustia emocional. Olivia, una vez dama de honor, secuestró los planes de boda, cambiando de lugar y de vestidos. Annie se siente traicionada y retira a Olivia de la fiesta nupcial. Olivia se defiende, dice que mejoró la boda.
Jennifer Lozada, de 46 años, demanda a su esposo y a su amante por enajenación de afecto.

Los Wilson demandan a Sean Moore, patrocinador de Ballpark Bandits, por 10.000 dólares. Su hijo fue despedido a mitad de temporada, Sean culpa al comportamiento errático de Kevin y a Laurie por fomentar la negatividad e intimidar a los padres.

Lola, del icónico programa infantil Plaza Sésamo, comparte cómo ella y el equipo de producción se adaptaron a la pandemia mediante video llamadas para seguir conectando con los niños. También hablan sobre los programas humanitarios de la organización, incluyendo su iniciativa más reciente para ayudar a los niños refugiados sirios desplazados por más de una década de guerra en Medio Oriente.

Luz Mary y Yon Fredy, tras perder tres embarazos, esperaban con ilusión a su bebé Salvador. En medio del paro nacional de 2021 en Colombia, con un embarazo de alto riesgo, quedaron atrapados en un bloqueo de manifestantes en el peaje de Sisga camino a Bogotá. Aunque finalmente los dejaron pasar, ya era demasiado tarde: perdieron a su bebé y con él, todas sus ilusiones de ser padres.

Michael dice que él y Britny no tuvieron relaciones sexuales lo suficiente como para que ella quedara embarazada. Shekeita y su hermana Natasha están aquí para demostrar que Kieary es el verdadero padre del bebé de Shekeita.

Monica tenía una relación con Deshan. Pero él y su madre, Tayama, afirman que solo fue una aventura de una sola vez. Más tarde, los rumores impiden que Joshua reclame al hijo de Deshan, ¡Joshua Jr.! ¿Quién es el padre biológico de Joshua Jr.?

Danica, una nueva mamá, recibió 5 correos electrónicos diferentes de 5 mujeres asegurando que se acostaron con su novio, Jimmy, en su casa. Entonces, ¿el novio de Renee preferirá su adicción a su familia?
Tina dejó a "G" tras revelar su embarazo y sufrir abusos. Sospecha que Patrice siembra dudas para separarlos. "G" dice que ella lo acosa, pero asegura querer estar presente en la vida del hijo.
¿Quién es responsable del bienestar del pequeño Noel? Todo el mundo puede negar las acusaciones, pero alguien sabe qué pasó, y Steve va a obtener explicaciones.
Deja enfrenta al padre de su hijo por el número de su amiga; Christian quiso hacer lo correcto tras un bebé pero estuvo con otra; Davonta dice que su ex está loca y quiere ser libre.

Otro hombre puede frustrar los planes de Devin de tener una relación con una estudiante universitaria; Zhane descubre quién ha estado ocupando el tiempo de su novio; Emily y su hermano se enteran de que sus parejas se han vuelto demasiado cercanas.
Destiny confronta a su amiga por invadir la propiedad de otras personas; una confesión de proporciones épicas podría ser un factor decisivo; un secreto oculto puede alterar los planes de una pareja.

Percy debe elegir entre la madre de su bebé y su otra mujer; Mary se entera de que su prometido se ha acostado con su amiga; Casey se pregunta si debería volver con un hombre que miente constantemente.
¡Es la batalla de los ex! Tony lucha para recuperar a su ex-amante. Richard le cuenta a su esposa que ha tenido un romance y ve a Lisa, su ex-amante, luchar por recuperarlo.
Danny planea dejar a la madre de su hijo por una stripper; Richard le confiesa a su prometida que la engañó mientras ella estaba encerrada; Dorreon quiere poner fin a su relación.
Cuando dos granjeros conocidos desaparecen, la policía rastrea un teléfono para encontrar al sospechoso.

Se sigue el rastro de denuncias ciudadanas sobre maltrato animal, feminicidios, negligencia en geriátricos y cirugías estéticas. Casos de justicia demorada y respuestas ciudadanas que exigen sanciones y reformas, luchando por la verdad y la justicia.

Miles de familias colombianas buscan tener casa propia, pero muchas son engañadas. En San Gil, José Luis Sierra y otros invirtieron en un proyecto de vivienda que resultó ser una estafa. En Flandes, Freddy Hernández y su esposa Edna también fueron víctimas de un proyecto sin permisos. Las autoridades investigan.

En Aguachica, un joven prometió grandes ganancias con criptomonedas, pero desapareció con el dinero de los inversionistas. En Bogotá, Daniel Gómez ofreció rentabilidades del 8% con su empresa Taurex, pero tampoco cumplió. La criptomoneda Daily Cop también dejó a miles sin su dinero. Las estafas suman millones de dólares.

En Colombia, varios casos de muertes neonatales han revelado graves negligencias médicas. Las familias afectadas buscan justicia. La falta de leyes que protejan a las madres ha llevado a impulsar una legislación para prevenir la tragedia.

El juicio por el asesinato de María Mercedes Gnecco sigue siendo un enigma. José Manuel Gnecco, principal sospechoso, insiste en su inocencia, mientras nuevas pruebas y la controversia sobre el arma homicida complican aún más el caso.

Ante la creciente delincuencia y la ineficacia policial, los ciudadanos recurren a la seguridad privada, la unión y vigilancia organizada surgen como respuesta urgente, evidenciando vacíos en la justicia y protección policial.
En Tame, Arauca, un militar fue condenado a 60 años por violar y asesinar brutalmente a tres niños. El Tribunal Superior de Bogotá lo encontró culpable de acceso carnal violento y homicidio agravado.

En 2015, en Arboledas, Norte de Santander, Cecilio Villamizar, el "Monstruo de Castro", abusó sexualmente de su hija de 13 años y asesinó a su hermano cuando este le pidió entregarse. Meses después mató también a su tío por temor a ser delatado. Finalmente, la menor rompió su silencio y denunció los abusos ante la Fiscalía. Villamizar fue condenado a 27 años de prisión por acceso carnal violento, acto sexual abusivo y homicidio agravado.

Una historia de amor en Barranquilla termina en tragedia en Canadá. Patricia es asesinada por su esposo al descubrir infidelidad. Tras un juicio, él es condenado. Los hijos quedan al cuidado del hermano de Daniel.

En 2013, Andrés Felipe Fierro, joven ingeniero ambiental, fue asesinado en 'Charco Azul', Florencia, Caquetá. La investigación reveló que Rocío Quintero, su amante, y Jarol Villegas, esposo de ella, estuvieron involucrados en el crimen. Un testigo clave confirmó las sospechas. Jarol confesó ser el autor intelectual y fue condenado a 32 años de prisión. Rocío permanece prófuga, rehaciendo su vida en Argentina.

En Soacha, Doris Góngora y su hija de 8 años fueron halladas asesinadas en su vivienda. Evidencia de sangre, huellas y registros telefónicos llevaron a los investigadores hasta Jorge Antonio Trujillo, sobrino de Doris. A pesar de negar los cargos, las pruebas forenses lo vincularon directamente con el doble crimen. Fue condenado a 60 años de prisión por homicidio agravado y hurto calificado.

En 2013, María Isabel Delgado y su hija Selena desaparecieron en Pasto, Nariño. Tras días de búsqueda, se reveló que Milton, esposo de María Isabel y también su primo, las había asesinado para ocultar que era padre de otra bebé fruto de una relación extramarital secreta. Los cuerpos fueron hallados enterrados con señales de violencia. Milton fue declarado autor intelectual del doble homicidio y condenado a 33 años de prisión.
Giselle está demandando a su padre, Albert Martinez, por angustia emocional y $145,000 por el costo de cancelar su boda.

Damien demanda a Sal por 35 millones de dólares, alegando que el servicio de transporte de Sal arruinó su matrimonio al dejar a su esposa en la casa de su amante. Sal niega la culpa y prioriza el crecimiento empresarial.
Miguel está demandando a su ex novia, Jasmine, por la totalidad de los $5 millones que ella ganó a través de un boleto instantáneo que compró con su tarjeta de crédito.

Samantha demanda a Elizabeth y al investigador privado Ricardo por 40.000 dólares por acusaciones falsas. Elizabeth contrató a Ricardo para investigar al marido de Samantha, pero acusó erróneamente a Samantha. Samantha denuncia acoso y difamación. Elizabeth y Ricardo niegan responsabilidad.

En 1993, Nancy Mestre, de 18 años, fue violada y asesinada por Jaime Saade Cormane tras salir con él en Nochevieja. Su padre, Martín, nunca se rindió: pasó 27 años investigando hasta descubrir que Saade había huido a Brasil bajo una nueva identidad. Gracias a su persistencia, fue capturado en 2020, aunque la extradición a Colombia sigue pendiente.

Carmenza López exige respuestas sobre el asesinato de su esposo Guillermo Leal, edil de Sumapaz secuestrado por las FARC en 2008. Aunque recibió un cuerpo, ella duda que fueran sus restos. Trece años después, sigue buscando la verdad, ahora como miembro de la Mesa de víctimas de Sumapaz, enfrentando a los desmovilizados sin darles el perdón que aún no siente merecido.

In a junkyard stalked by a ravenous creature, players must cross a narrow beam-rolling a tire as the beast lunges from below; it's a race against fear, balance, and time with the two slow eliminated; for the first time, a prize is revealed.

In a fog-shrouded graveyard, three teams of two are split-one locked in a chained coffin, the other racing to recover scattered remains and complete a ritual; time runs out for one team as they fail to assemble a skeleton before the clock expires.

In a decaying barn, the final four attempt a ritual to contain an ancient evil, but it fails; as the dead rise, the remaining three flee to an old farmhouse for the final challenge, where a competitor is crowned the winner.

Dive into a fruity chocolate journey today with Kirsten's lime and coconut-infused choux buns and a simple cream and raspberry tart. Kirsten also makes muddy snowballs with a twist, followed by mouthwatering chocolate brownie biscuits.
Jamie Oliver rustles up Moroccan bream, couscous salad, pomegranate, and harissa as well as beef burgers, shred salad, and pickles.

One home cook attempts to make a crowd-pleasing dish that’s nutritious and delicious, and the Wall of Chefs kitchen explodes with culture in the Chef’s Fridge round, which features staple ingredients from famed Japanese/Italian Chef Joël Watanabe.
Singer and performer Leo with the help of pro-chef Jasmine will try to fry chicken wings without burning down the kitchen. Will he succeed?
Hot mess express- versus edition: Two hot messes compete against each other on the same menu: Mac lead by chef-Andrea and Chris led by chef-Lauren. Who will make the tastier dish?

Get tangled in today's episode with Kirsten's creamy semifreddo paired with strawberries, or keep it simple and treat yourself with lovely chocolate lollipops. Kirsten also makes a marble cake that tastes as good as it looks and takes breakfast to the next level with mouthwatering brioche buns.

Host Sarah Sharratt is invited by her local mayor to accompany him on a seasonal pigeon hunt; a tradition that dates back hundreds of years in the region. The hunters inpire Sarah to throw a dinner party featuring stuffed pigeon on roasted fennel and pommes dauphinoise (potato gratin). For dessert Sarah makes an apple tresse with armagnac, another traditional ingredient she sources from a famous local producer.

Raymond Blanc pays culinary homage to his Maman Blanc by sharing nostalgic dishes from his childhood - Vegetable Soup Three Ways, and a special Assiette of Salads made with produce fresh from his gardens.
French cuisine is the heart of Raymond Blanc's repertoire, and his French classics have been on the menu at Le Manoir since the beginning.

Diana explores Korean food. Charlie Carrington (chef and owner of Atlas Dining) shows Diana how to ferment your own kimchi at home before cooking up a ‘Beef Bulgogi’, a dish of delicious marinated beef cooked at high heat and topped with quintessential Korean condiments. Diana decides to make a vegetarian version of ‘Bibimbap’.

The flavours of Indonesia are well loved across Asia. Diana decides to showcase her favourite spicy Indonesian relish, Sambal Matah, on top of a glorious whole snapper grilled in banana leaves. Jess Lemon (MasterChef) knows Indonesian cuisine back to front gets a little fancy for dessert with a dish called ‘Dury Wat’, which showcases the unique Indonesian fruit durian.

After a long and muddy winter, host Sarah Sharratt trades in her rubber boots for a pair of high heels during a culinary escape to Paris. Sarah explores the modern food scene in Paris and sets out to better understand how Parisians eat. From food markets to luxury food shops, from a private dinner party to a private cooking lesson with the city's hottest chef, Sarah leaves no cocktail unmixed or pastry uneaten in her gastronomic quest.

Spring has arrived in France and host Sarah Sharratt is hosting friends for a seasonally-inspired lunch. Sarah loves to indulge her guests with French classics and the Spring menu is sure to please: duck pâté, freshly-picked white asparagus, and a tower of colourful macaroons. Lucky for Sarah, there is a food adventure behind each dish.

Jamie is kicking off with his quick Steak Stir-Fry – perfectly delicious, speedy grub for when time is tight; Jamie then shares a cool, crunchy celebration of summer – his stunning Watermelon, Radish, and Feta Salad.

Jamie is cooking up four more outrageously tasty dishes. To get it all going he’s sharing his Sicilian Tuna Pasta – one of the fastest family suppers you can make – followed by his stunning dish with attitude: Sticky Teriyaki Eggplant.
Jenn joins the wild rice harvest in Northwest Saskatchewan before sharing a meal that uses the ingredient in creative ways
The combination of a flavoured custard filling topped with whipped cream is as important as apple pie on a diner menu, and with good reason – they are sinfully delicious.

All hail The Chocolate Queen, as Kirsten shows her chocolatey twist on everyone's favourite: churros with a rich chocolate fudge sauce. Following up Kirsten's irresistible coconut shortbread recipe, plus steamed chocolate baos that will undoubtedly be a crowd-pleaser.
Jamie Oliver rustles up pork steaks with Hungarian pepper sauce, plus killer fish and rice, beans, greens, and chili yogurt.

So when an eligible, handsome guy walks into her coffee shop, she turns on the charm, but he doesn’t respond to her flirting like men usually do. When she discovers that he runs a ministry that builds affordable housing, she decides to volunteer.

programmes.t: Cómo Encontrar a Alguien Que Sea para Siempre
programmes.d: A Marley se le da genial organizar los compromisos de los demás, pero no tiene suerte a la hora de encontrar el amor. Cuando diseña su propuesta más importante hasta la fecha, el hombre que podría ponerlo todo en peligro puede ser el que la ayude a encontrar su propia historia de amor.

Un influencer de las redes sociales lleva a su novia al desierto con la intención de transmitir en vivo su propuesta, pero las cosas toman un giro inesperado después de que ella se resbala por un acantilado. Se necesita estar separados en la naturaleza y superar los obstáculos de la naturaleza para que ambos se den cuenta de que es posible que no sean el uno para el otro, mientras encuentran el amor en lugares nuevos e inesperados, como un viejo amor convertido en voluntario de rescate y una gua

A una ambiciosa gestora de proyectos le ofrecen la oportunidad profesional de su vida en Londres. Pero cuando regresa a su ciudad natal para ayudar al negocio familiar en una emergencia y conoce al chico perfecto, su pasión y talento por la pintura se reavivan, dándole una nueva perspectiva de la vida y el amor.

Para la estudiante de arte Abby la vida en el campus va sobre ruedas, incluyendo su relación con su novio Simon. Él ha sido el chico de sus sueños desde siempre, pero cuando el encantador Quinn irrumpe en su vida, Abby tendrá que verse en la disyuntiva de elegir...

Para evitar que la editorial en la que trabaja sea vendida, Becca, una joven editora, tiene que viajar a Arcania con la famosa estrella de acción Lee para conseguir los derechos cinematográficos de la popular serie "Lover's Quest".

Jo, una aspirante a escritora, se marcha a Nueva York decidida a publicar una novela, pero su editor la reta a escribir sobre algo más interesante: su familia. Cuando una tragedia lleva a las hermanas de vuelta a casa, permanecer unidas adquiere un nuevo significado. Mientras Jo consuela a su hermana enferma, Beth le pide una cosa: una historia.

Cuando un canal de televisión anuncia que su programa de terapia psicológica será cambiado por un show de escándalos públicos, una bondadosa psicóloga firme en sus convicciones regresa a su pueblo y se reúne con el amor de su juventud. Eventualmente, se da cuenta de que tener a alguien con quien compartir la vida es más importante que la fama o la emoción de la ciudad.

Cuando una escritora romántica se enamora de su camarero, se encuentra en conflicto. ¿Merece la pena comprometerse en una relación y perder a un amigo y, posiblemente, su trabajo?

Un joven cantante de country sueña con triunfar en Nashville y empieza a salir con una popular animadora, pero ella no comparte su amor por la música. Cuando su carrera despega, debe elegir entre el amor y seguir su destino pase lo que pase.

Nicole, una bloguera de viajes de éxito, conoce a Kade, representante de marketing de una editorial de viajes, y entablan una relación mientras exploran una isla.

The SCL train stopped in Zlatibor for the stage 6 of the MLO SCL. 11 compete for the title in the home country of legendary Ervin Katona.
Bulgaria hosts the next stage of the SCL. Current leader in the World Series is Matjaz Belsak, youngest competitor and strongest man of Slovenia.
The competitors battle it out in the special event, the Atlas Steel Stone. This stone is made completely from iron and cannot be touched with any support.
This stage sees the strongmen visit Vaasa, Finland. Residents here are familiar with the competition because some of the SCL icons are from their country.
38 athletes compete in the under 90kg and under 105kg SCL World Championships. From each weight class, the top 12 qualify for the finals.
A two day, seven event battle with lots of spectators.
Alex Moonen is leading. Part two of the competition in Romania showcases a new challenge - Hercules Hold.
In this stage in Curacao no one wants to lose the chance to fight for one kilo gold in World grand finals in Dubai.
The last chance to qualify for the World Grand Finale. Zageris and Belsak fight for the better position for the finals.
We reach Dubai where we will crown the new champion for SCL 2016. This is part one of the world finals.
In this last episode, the best athletes compete in Pole Push, Deadlift, Forward Hold and Loading.

We are in beautiful Norway for the kick off of the 2017 MLO Strongman Champions League season. With partly cloudy weather and lots of snow, we have the perfect scenery for the athletes, who prepare for the first contest of the year.

A definite highlight in this FIBO edition in Germany, Strongman Champions League introduced its new rules for a special team item. Graham Hicks tries here to set a New World Record on the biggest log in the world, currently held by Krzysztof Radzikowski. Boosted also by the presence of the acclaimed in the strongman circles names of Mark Felix and Danis Zageris.

This weekend sees the Strongman Champions League Log Lift World Championships in Lithuania. Big lifting names such as Graham Hicks , Vidas Blekaitis and Vytatus Lalas are in the startlist to push some big numbers.

The battle of the Dutch will take place this edition in Lichtenvoorde, a place very well known in Holland because of the famous “Black Cross”. The athletes will compete over six heavy events and the winner gets 25 Strongman Champions League ranking points.

Set in the beautiful mountain resort Zlatibor, the fifth stage of the Strongman Champions League 2017 sees 14 athletes from across the world competing for the gold medal of SCL Serbia 2017. The event welcomes top-athlete - and odds-on favourite - Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia), who has presented himself in an impressive shape so far. Can his opponents defeat him?

See professional surfers like Ben Bourgeois, Asher Nolan, The Hobgoods, Dean Morrison, Aaron Cormican, Gabe Kling, Jesse Hines, Matt Gilligan, and many more surfing in Australia, Hawaii, Indonesia, Costa Rica, South Africa, East Coast and California in truly epic conditions.
From beaches to streets, All Tha Way Live takes you on a journey with some of the planet's best surfers.

As the end of the season approaches, the captains' wager raises the stakes.

Two boats fish through a storm, but only one comes out on top.

The season's opilio crab tally is in, and a winner is declared.
The fleet sets off to brave the deadly Bering Sea and cash in on king crab.
The Time Bandit pulls a prank on the Cornelia Marie.
The Northwestern deals with a mechanical breakdown and a dangerous repair.
Greenhorns, skippers and family fishing dynasties begin to crack.
Tempers flare aboard the Wizard and the Northwestern.
Things look good for the Wizard with a few weeks left in king crab season.
Mass amounts of stinging jellyfish in unfilled pots add insult to injury.
The boats experience deck accidents, power outages and more.
Opilio crab season begins, and a dual storm system puts lives at risk.
A Coast Guard rescue turns dangerous, and a greenhorn challenges a captain.
One captain has an accident while showing off for his deck crew.
The Cornelia Marie crew has to force Phil to get medical attention.
The Cornelia Marie helm changes hands when Phil heads to the hospital.
Captain Phil's future on the Cornelia Marie is in question.

Scott's friends pledge to protect him against an increasingly hostile enemy, while Argent, Isaac and Allison search the past for answers to the shadow creatures. At the same time, Stiles, fearing he is going insane, reaches out to Melissa for help.

After suffering from hallucinations for some time, Stiles (Dylan O'Brien) mysteriously disappears one night and it's up to Scott (Tyler Posey) and the gang to figure out whether he has been kidnapped…and if the Oni had anything to do with it.

Stiles (Dylan O'Brien) mysteriously reappears, but is he himself? Meanwhile, Scott (Tyler Posey) must prevent a disaster and Lydia (Holland Roden) and Allison (Crystal Reed) seek help from an unlikely source...Peter Hale (Ian Bohen).

Stiles checks himself into a mental hospital named Echo House where he believes he will be safe from the Nogitsune. Will he be as far away from it as he thinks or closer than ever? Meanwhile Scott, Allison and Lydia look for a cure for him.

While Allison, Derek, Chris and Sheriff Stilinski try to track down Nogitsune, Kira's mother tells the story of the Nogitsune she came to know. Meanwhile, the Nogitsune has taken complete control of Stiles and manages to stay one step ahead.

With the Nogitsune still in control of their friend Stiles, Scott and Lydia find an unlikely ally in Peter Hale. Elsewhere, the effects of the Nogitsune have given Chris, Alison and Kira some trouble with four out-of-control werewolves.

Scott (Tyler Posey) and company race to rescue Lydia (Holland Roden) from the clutches of evil and get help from a young woman who has escaped from the metal hospital. But the Nogitsune makes a surprise move, resulting in a tragic loss to the group.

In the Season 4 finale, struck by disaster and nearly defeated, Scott (Tyler Posey) and Derek (Tyler Hoechlin) call on their friends and allies to make one last stand against the Nogitsune. And someone thought dead makes a surprising return.
Scott and his Pack journey into Mexico to rescue a missing friend.
Scott must turn to an unlikely ally in order to stop Kate's plan.
A new Freshman player threatens Scott's position on the Lacrosse team. Stilinski investigates a brutal murder.
Uninvited guests arrive at Lydia's lake house on the night of the full moon. Derek tracks down a killer.

As another name is scratched off the list, Lydia is required to find the second key, thus revealing more targets. Scott, Stiles and Kira are on high alert after realizing that the assassin is on the lacrosse team.
With Violet's arrest, Garrett forces Scott to help get her back by using Liam as a bargaining chip. Stiles, Lydia and Jordan seek Meredith's help to uncover the third key.

A frantic call to the CDC has everyone paranoid, especially since it was designed to target werewolves. Scott, Malia and Kira lock themselves in the Hale vault, unaware of their salvation within their grasp.

With Noshiko's help, the team come up with a plan hoping to reveal the benefactor's identity. But Kate's arrival threatens to ruin it all. Malia comes face-to-face with Peter in the Hale vault, thus delving into her past.

After a vain attempt to kill Parrish, it's clear that almost everyone has access to the dead-pool. Lydia dives into her grandmother's past, uncovering yet another list which leads her to Eichen House. The team soon realizes no one is safe.
Scott and Kira fight to protect Satomi's pack from assassins. Stiles and Malia learn the origins of The Dead Pool.
Scott and his Pack begin a dangerous battle against an old enemy.
Scott and Stiles return to La Iglesia in order to save the pack from Kate.
On the night before the start of Senior Year, Scott and his Pack are challenged by the arrival of a new enemy and the return of an old friend.
Stiles tries to prove his suspicions about a new classmate while Lydia helps a student with night terrors.
Scott tracks a dangerous new shapeshifter threatening Stilinski. Malia receives information about her mother’s identity.
Stiles tries to track down a fugitive. Liam tries to play wingman to Mason at a nightclub.
The Pack goes into Eichen House to learn more about The Dread Doctors.
Scott and his friends experience strange effects after following Dr. Valack’s advice.
Scott’s plan to protect the newest victim goes awry when The Dread Doctors attack.
Scott and Malia attempt to rescue their captured friends. Deaton makes a horrific discovery about The Dread Doctors.
While Scott turns to an unlikely ally for help, Stiles and Lydia try to uncover the truth about Parrish.
Scott and his pack face their greatest enemy yet, with both lives and friendships on the verge of being destroyed.
Scott and Stiles must strive to figure out what's behind the mysterious infection that's killing the town sheriff in spite of their deep rift.
Without the support of his pack, Scott confronts what the Dread Doctors' deadly success means for Beacon Hills.
Kira and her mother take extreme measures to help Kira deal with her dark side while Lydia is surprised at Eichen House.
As Scott tries to put his pack back together, Malia and a new ally set out to rescue Deaton from The Desert Wolf.
After discovering Lydia is in imminent danger, Stiles creates a desperate plan to break her out of Eichen House. Unbeknownst to Scott and his pack, however, Theo has his own plans for Lydia.
Trapped in Eichen House with Theo and his Chimera Pack, Scott must try to rescue Lydia before it’s too late.
Scott and his pack use a charity lacrosse game in a deadly gambit to figure out the identity of the Beast.
Hoping to align with a familiar ally, the Argents reveal a key clue to the mystery of the Beast of Gevaudan.  Meanwhile, Scott tries to take on the Beast himself.
With the identity of the Beast finally revealed, Scott and his friends are in a race against time to stop the Dread Doctors from implementing their final plan.
Loyalties are tested and new alliances forged as Scott and his friends work to stop the Beast before Beacon Hills is razed to the ground.
With graduation approaching, a supernatural force rides into Beacon Hills and crosses paths with Scott and his friends, while Liam discovers evidence of a new enemy in the high school.
While Scott, Lydia and Malia search for lost memories of a missing friend, Corey discovers a connection between his abilities and the Wild Hunt.
While Scott, Lydia and Malia search for Stiles, Liam and the others throw a party to keep a friend safe from the Ghost Riders.
Scott and Liam protect the lacrosse team from an attack by the Ghost Riders while Lydia searches for clues that lead her closer to finding Stiles.
Trapped inside the Wild Hunt, Stiles reunites with an unexpected ally while Scott, Lydia and Malia discover Stiles’s Jeep may be connected to his disappearance.
Scott, Lydia and Malia search for clues about the Wild Hunt in a mysterious place called Canaan while Liam and Hayden resort to drastic measures in the fight against the Ghost Riders.
Scott and Liam attempt to capture a Ghost Rider while Malia and Peter search for a way into the Wild Hunt.
Running out of time, Scott, Lydia and Malia decide to storm the rift in a desperate attempt to get Stiles back. Liam, Hayden and Mason make a deal with Theo in order to learn Douglas's real plan.
While Liam and Theo act as decoys, Scott, Lydia and Malia enact a desperate plan to try and remember Stiles.

Henry Marshall (Frank Whaley) is a greedy man. Recently released from prison, Marshall has learned little from his experiences. But an encounter with alien beings (Rebecca De Mornay and John Savage) may just teach him a thing or two.

On a remote planet, Major Stokes (Robert Patrick), one of Earth's best warriors, has been captured by aliens and placed in a cell with a woman who is slowly being transformed into one of the aliens. Can he escape before he suffers a similar fate?

Hanna Velasic (Alyssa Milano) has a killer body...literally! When the formerly chaste beauty is taken over by a mysterious force, he appetite for men becomes insatiable...and murderous. Can her loving boyfriend put an end to her killing spree?

When a group of astronauts returning to Earth after an expedition to Mars discover what appears to be a dangerous alien life form on their ship, they must decide whether to return to Earth or sacrifice themselves for the sake of all humanity?

To cure his cancer, a man (Peter Outerbridge) secretly injects himself with experimental nanobots that his scientist friend (Richard Thomas) developed. The trial is successful -- too successful -- when the super 'bots try to create a superhuman!

Jennifer (Marlee Matlin), deaf since birth, has had a revolutionary implant in her ear, to help her hear for the first time. The device doesn't help her to hear normal conversation and sounds, but she does hear...something...from The Outer Limits.

When a robot named Adam is accused of killing his own creator, it's up to a civil liberties attorney (Leonard Nimoy) to defend him. Is Adam capable of murder? Or did a military retrofit of the docile robot turn him into a ruthless killing machine?

Lynda is a grieving mother who feels her son's spirit is haunting her. Levi is a scientist out to prove that ghosts do not exist. Can her faith and his skepticism come together to solve the mystery of  a haunted house and a senseless death?

An environmentally friendly U.S. Senator's life changes when, after a freak accident, he suddenly starts to believe he is an alien in disguise, with a "mission" to surreptitiously reconfigure the Earth's atmosphere. But is it for the better?

Randall Strong (Gordon Clapp) is on a mission to convince the US Military that aliens are threatening Earth, but committee Chairman Thornwell (Daniel J. Travanti) seems to be Strong's biggest stumbling block. Could Thornewll be one of... "them"?

FBI agent Jamie Pratt (Michelle Forbes) investigates a perplexing case when her best friend becomes a killer's next victim. The mystery takes her through five decades of time, where reality changes at each and every turn...in the Outer Limits.

Life on Earth has been wiped out by biological warfare, with androids the only survivors. Two such androids (Heather Graham, Dana Ashbrook) recreate a human from DNA and must protect him from a military force which wants humankind annihilated.

Howard (Alan Ruck) and Joanne (Catherine Mary Stewart) are happily expecting their first child. They live in a world where genetic alteration is rampantly purchased on the black market...but nothing comes without a price in The Outer Limits.

After intercepting a strange phone call, a tenacious reporter (Ally Sheedy) finds herself in a deadly game of cat and mouse. The only clues to the mystery: a strange man with violet eyes and missing persons who leave behind a pile of purple ash.

When an accident puts Dr. Stein's (Mark Hamill) colleague, Rachel, in a coma, he uses his newly-created invention to reach her brain and tell her he loves her. However, Stein discovers that love takes strange turns when it enters the virtual world.

After flashbacks of an alien abduction lead him to attempt suicide, Eddie Wexler (Michael O'Keefe) is institutionalized, with a doctor who seems intent on forcing him to relive his "memories." Is Eddie insane? Or is the doctor more than he seems?

As he celebrates his first anniversary, Norman (Matt Frewer) thinks he's the luckiest man alive. But suddenly, his lovely wife doesn't seem the same and he can't stand to be around her. Is he going crazy or are his instincts telling him something?

Problem child Rusty (Ryan Phillippe) finds himself thrown into a private school bent on straightening him out with some unorthodox methods. Rusty has eluded their control so far, but can he escape from this prison of the mind?

On the first day of his presidency, Charles Halsey (Robert Foxworth) is faced with the first galactic foreign policy decision. As aliens are approaching Earth, the peace-loving president must determine if they are invaders or benevolent explorers.

In a bizarre twist of fate, Nancy McDonald (Bonnie Bedelia) receives a distress call from Lindy (Chad Willett), a former lover, who was lost in space twenty years earlier. And he has a message: He's alive...and he desperately needs her help.

A man (James Wilder) finds himself in what seems to be a refuge in a post-apocalyptic world, lorded over by a sadistic industrialist (M. Emmet Walsh) who pits his guests against one another for enjoyment...but all is not what it seems to be.

When a lonely physics professor Stanley Hurst (Michael Gross) realizes the sun is going to burn out, he knows that he and humanity have only a few hours to live. In that time, Stan resolves to make up for lost years.

Howie (Neil Patrick Harris), a boy with intellectual disabilities, is the last unaffected person in a town overrun by a strange, parasitic madness. On his own for the first time, Howie has only himself to rely upon if he wants to save his sister!

After a friend's betrayal cost him his Army career, Lee Taylor (Costas Mandylor) helps a self-styled militia Major hijack an Army shipment. Expecting missiles, they find a mysterious cargo and a lone Army Guard who warns of its deadly capability.

Convicted of a murder he didn't commit, Linden Stiles can either accept execution or become the subject of a military experiment. Choosing to live, he finds himself slowly dehumanized by the alien DNA that has been injected into him.

With Earth under alien rule, humanity has been programmed into slavery. A band of rebels kidnap Evan (Erich Anderson), one of the alien leader's slaves. After a twist of fate, Evan agrees to assassinate his former master...with devastating results.

When three young women age and die within hours, a small town is turned upside down. How does Helen (Maxine Miller), a doctor's aging mother, play into these deaths? The answer to the puzzling mystery of fragile youth is soon to be revealed.

On a desperate mission to survive, a young military cadet (Will Wheaton) learns the difference between heroic ideals and the bitter realities of war as he and his dying comrades prepare a strike against the aliens who may have condemn them to death.

What really happens during an out-of-body experience? Scientist Rebecca (Peri Gilpin) is so desperate to find out that she decides run an experiment on herself. But not everyone is happy of the lengths science will go to for empirical proof.

Inventor Dr. Jack Henson (David Hyde Pierce) comes up with a "virtual prison" where criminals serve a life sentence in just a few, cost-efficient hours. When an innocent man's life is at stake, the doctor must submit himself to his own invention.

In a post-apocalyptic underground bunker, a virtual reality world begins to turn on its inventor (Jon Tenney) after he becomes romantically involved with -- and then spurns -- the holographic interface (Natasha Henstridge) that controls the system.

A mentally challenged man (Howie Mandel) is made more intelligent by a machine that transfers people's memories and experiences into his head, but kills its victims. And he soon discovers that the mind can be a minefield in The Outer Limits.

After a couple's son dies, an experimental procedure harvests the boy's nerve cells, allowing the mother to give birth to a genetically identical child. But soon it becomes clear that this fetus is not just identical…it is actually Justin himself.

A man's family is turned upside down when he discovers that his son's college sweetheart is the same woman he rescued from a secret military experiment twenty years before...only she has not aged a day since. Peter Onorati and Fred Savage star.

When "the Stream" -- an artificial system providing information to all society members through computer chips implanted in their brains -- begins to malfunction, an unlikely, "primitive" man (George Newbern) may be the mankind's only hope.

After a chemical war renders the world's population unable to conceive healthy children, a mother and father must escape from a sinister government agency intent on using their miraculously healthy newborn to repopulate the species.

In a society imprisoned for generations by extraterrestrial who invaded Earth, an electronics expert (Harley Jane Kozak) discovers that not only are her human jailers really machines, but they also have been holding prisoners for nearly a century.

A preacher descends upon the 18th century town of Heart's Desire and offers to share his extraordinary powers with four outlaws. But who is this stranger and why has he given these outlaws such deadly powers? Caspar Van Dien and Esai Morales star.

Attempting to deliver serum to a plague-stricken planet, a pilot (Eric McCormack) and his crew crash land on an unknown moon. Bitten by an alien spider while fixing the ship, the pilot's mind wanders between alternate realities…in The Outer Limits.

A woman unable to feel emotions gets a new lease on life when a brain implant allows her to experience feelings for the first time. But, when the implant malfunctions, driving her towards insanity, she is shocked at the real cause of her problems.

A remorseless, uncaring scientist (Stephen Lang) and his partner (Michael Ontkean) discover a way to bring life back to the recently deceased. But after the scientist is killed and brought back to life himself, will he choose to live differently?

Brilliant geneticist Martin Nodel (Ron Rifkin) unlocks a secret code imprinted on human DNA. But when he tests this code on himself, his "instincts" draw him to a remote location where he finds a trip…to The Outer Limits. Ryan Reynolds co-stars.

When it is not known if aliens headed to Earth are friend or foe, five people are placed in secret bunkers to man switches that, if not pressed at specified intervals, will set off mass destruction that will destroy everything, alien or human alike.

Engaged as soldiers on a distant planet to prevent a race of alien bugs from stealing minerals that provide the Earth's energy, a woman (Christine Elise) and her troops accidentally discover that the real enemy may not be the aliens at all.

When a seemingly harmless audio signal from space causes physiological changes in Earth's youth, a young scientist races against time to discover what exactly is happening and why. Could the changes be necessary for the survival of the planet?

Great Destinations of the World takes you to some of the most beautiful and exotic places on the planet. With unbelievable views and fascinating commentary, you will discover these exquisite destinations hold more history than you ever imagined. Travel to picturesque locations in America, Africa, Asia, and Europe. Learn the history of each place, delight in the local cuisine, listen to native music, and leave with feeling like you just experienced some of the most exciting places on the planet.

The State of the Presidi is a swampy, malarial land, which, thanks only to human resilience and intelligence, became a centre of wealth and culture. The journey starts from the Metalliferous Hills of Maremma, rich in raw metals and the historical capital of mining territory, and continues to the historical buildings and the ancient water springs of Massa Maratima with its famous Fertility Tree.

Brian and Nick are back out on the road again and pull into the beautiful town of Bristol, New Hampshire. Join them as they hit the Cog Railway to the summit of Mt. Washington, explore the world's cleanest lake, relive their youth in a classic arcade museum, and visit with some critters native to the area!

Nick & Brian road trip to the great state of Michigan to the lakeside town of Grand Haven. Join them as they head out with the Coast Guard, meet an award winning brewmaster, go behind the scenes of a massive water fountain show, find a blueberry haven, and experience the delectable work of some incredible sandwich artisans!

Nick checks out the beautiful waterfront town of Scituate, Massachusetts. He experiences sport fishing, Irish mossing, homemade ice cream and lobster mac and cheese. Then he climbs the most expensive, musical water tower in the world.

Nick is on the road again and this time to a town that is right on the Erie Canal. Lockport, New York! He experiences a day in the life of a legendary Buffalo Bills fan. Then he chows down at Danny Sheehan's Steak House before exploring the underworld at the Lockport Caves.

This town is right on the banks of the Potomac River. Join Brian and Nick as they hit The Bavarian Inn, explore the town's history, make gourmet popcorn, and visit the battlefield that is known as The Bloodiest Day in American History.

Nick road trips to actress Katharine Hepburn's hometown of Old Saybrook. He tours The Kate, learns what the locals are doing to revive the oyster beds, cooks up some sea scallops at Liv's, and hits the shores in search of oystercatchers.

Wellsboro PA aka The Town That Saved Christmas is a classic storybook town with nostalgic gas-lit streets. Nick quickly finds out about its glassmaking past and comes across a chocolate factory with an incredible mission. He chows down at the Steak House and travels deep into the PA Grand Canyon!

Nick rolls into to this central pa town and visits the historic Campus Theater where he satisfies one of his life long quests. Then he checks out a restaurant that has mastered the art of the smashburger! He'll witness the making of some of the best snowboards in the world, then close out this road trip by hitting Mecum's Auto Auction where the Caddy awaits him after its new restoration.

This gem in the beautiful Mountain State is known for its connection to John Brown's raid. Hop in the seat and ride along as Nick travels back in time to a candy store that uses centuries old recipes and chows down at a restaurant specializing in vegan delights. Then take a walk on the Appalachian Trail with an AT Legend!

This historic town northwest of Boston played a significant role in the American Revolutionary War. Come along as Nick explores the Minuteman National Historical Park, visits the Concord Museum, and takes a stroll through Authors Ridge, the resting place of famous authors such as Henry David Thoreau and Ralph Waldo Emerson. Discover the rich history of this charming New England town.

Brian and Nick check out the Caboose Motel, indulge in delicious eats at Fat Chad's, and learn about the influential journalist Ida Tarbell. They make some smiley cookies and of course find out all they can about the birthplace of the oil industry and the global impact Titusville had on the rest of the world.

Nick travels to a New Jersey beach town known as "the bubble" where he visits not one but two chocolate shops that make time tested treats. Then he hits a seafood restaurant serving the freshest of fresh blue fin tuna. He tours a historic home, visits the local theater and museum then rides drop top around town to take in the stunning residential architecture.
Brian and Nick hit the "Marble City" Rutland, Vermont! Join them as they explore the Red Clover Inn, Table 24 and the Vermont Marble Museum. Then hit the hills and checkout some mountain adventure.
